jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you ready to develop software for high-end printing systems in an international R&D environment? Turn complex engine er
ing challenges into reliable applications and embedded solutions that make a visible impact. Get in touch with us!

Questions about this job?

Jeroen Veugelers, HR, +316 – 34885207 / Jeroen.veugelers@cpp.canon

Junior Software Engineer

32-40 hours per week, hybrid in Venlo (NL)

What You’ll Do

As a Junior Software Engineer, you develop applications and system software for our high-end printing products and workflow solutions. You work with .NET Core, C#, Entity Framework and Angular/TypeScript across cloud, desktop, on-premises and printer-controller environments. In close collaboration with software, electronics, mechanics and chemistry specialists, you help turn complex product requirements into robust, testable software.

You’ll Be Responsible For

Designing, implementing and testing software components in C# and/or Angular/TypeScript
Developing microservices and user interfaces for printing and workflow products
Integrating software with printer controllers, embedded systems and cloud environments
Reviewing code and improving quality through automated and component testing
Contributing ideas, prototypes and technical solutions within an agile team

Who You’ll Work With

Our international organization has a flat hierarchy, so you’ll be working with lots of other people in an open, creative multidisciplinary environment. That includes colleagues in software, electronics, mechanics and chemistry, as well as development teams in Venlo, Timișoara and Poing.

What You Bring

We’re looking for a team player who meets the following requirements:

A Master’s degree in Computer Science, Informatics or a comparable field
Up to 5 years of professional software development experience
Basic experience with C# and/or Angular/TypeScript through study, internship or work
An interest in embedded systems, microservices and multidisciplinary product development
Knowledge of AI technologies, machine learning and software modelling is considered a plus
A proactive approach to learning, problem-solving and taking ownership of your work
Fluent English skills, both spoken and written

What You’ll Get From Us

We provide an exciting, dynamic work environment with plenty of opportunity for you to develop personally and professionally. We offer excellent conditions to help you be who you want to be:

A competitive salary in line with your educational background and experience
38 vacation days
13th month bonus (8.6%) until end of 2026 paid either monthly or yearly. As of 1 January 2027 the 13th-month bonus will be discontinued, which means that as of that date the 13th-month bonus will be fully converted to the (scale) salary.
Hybrid working for a healthy work-life balance
A huge range of training and professional development opportunities
A laptop and smartphone
An interesting lease (e-)bike plan

Career opportunities

In this role there are plenty of opportunities to further develop yourself, for example towards software engineer, senior software engineer, technical specialist or software architect.

What do we stand for?

We develop and manufacture high-tech printing products and workflow software for the commercial printing market as part of Canon, a global leader in imaging technologies. With around 3,300 employees across three continents and our headquarters in Venlo, the Netherlands, we innovate to create high-quality solutions that add color to the world. Guided by the philosophy of Kyosei —living and working together for the common good—our culture is built on openness, collegiality, trust and stability. We empower our people to grow, take initiative, and make an impact.

With our company values collaboration, innovation and ownership, we strive to bring out the best in each other, expand boundaries and feel empowered to take ownership of our work.

Further information about Canon Production Printing is available at cpp.canon.

jobs.title: AI Developer – Microsoft Azure & Foundry
jobs.description:
Digital Bricks is een Microsoft Solutions Partner gespecialiseerd in Data & AI. Wij helpen organisaties om voorbij de experimenteerfase te stappen en AI met meetbare impact in te zetten: van Microsoft 365 Copilot en Copilot Studio tot AI-agents en Microsoft Foundry. Onze aanpak is mensgericht. Voor ons horen technologie, adoptie, governance en het versterken van medewerkers onlosmakelijk bij elkaar.

Digital Bricks is ruim vier jaar geleden opgericht in Amsterdam en bedient klanten door heel Europa en daarbuiten. Als onderdeel van de Novature Group fungeren wij als het Center of Excellence voor AI.

Over de functie

Wij zoeken een ervaren en gemotiveerde AI Developer – Microsoft Azure & Foundry om ons team te versterken. In deze rol bouw je aan moderne, enterprise-grade AI-applicaties, agents en cloudintegraties binnen de Microsoft-cloud.

Dit is primair een ontwikkelrol gericht op Azure, waarbij het zwaartepunt ligt op het koppelen van Large Language Models (LLMs) en agent-architecturen aan bestaande bedrijfssystemen, Microsoft 365 en enterprise databronnen. Je werkt nauw samen met AI-consultants, solution architects en klanten om zakelijke vereisten te vertalen naar schaalbare, veilige en productieklare oplossingen.

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

AI-architectuur & Agents: Ontwerpen en implementeren van generatieve AI-modellen, agent-gebaseerde structuren, prompt-orchestratie, evaluatie-pipelines en RAG-architecturen met Microsoft Foundry en Azure AI Search.
Enterprise Integraties: Bouwen van veilige backend-integratielagen (REST API’s, webhooks, queues, event-driven patronen) om AI-diensten te koppelen aan ERP-, CRM- en SaaS-systemen via Azure Logic Apps, Functions en API Management.
Microsoft 365 & Graph API: Intensief gebruikmaken van de Microsoft Graph API voor diepe integratie van AI-functionaliteiten binnen Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, Entra ID en organisatiedata.
Cloud, Security & DevOps: Implementeren van identiteits- en toegangsbeheer (OAuth 2.0, Entra ID, Managed Identities), Azure Key Vault, Infrastructure as Code (Bicep/Terraform) en CI/CD-pipelines via Azure DevOps of GitHub.

Vereiste kennis en ervaring

Core Stack: Ruime hands-on ervaring met Python, C# / .NET of TypeScript / Node.js.
Azure Ecosystem: Grondige ervaring met Azure App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Container Apps/AKS, Storage, Key Vault en Azure Monitor / Application Insights.
Microsoft Foundry & GenAI: Praktijkervaring met LLM-implementaties, vector search, embeddings, prompt engineering, tool/function calling en Responsible AI-richtlijnen.
Enterprise Graph & Auth: Goed begrip van de Microsoft Graph API, Entra ID app-registraties, delegated/application permissions en OAuth 2.0-stromen.
Data & Storage: Ervaring met het veilig ontsluiten van enterprise data via Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure AI Search of Microsoft Fabric.

Wensen (nice-to-have)

Microsoft Power Platform: Ervaring met Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Power Apps of Custom Connectors om low-code oplossingen te verbinden met Azure AI-workflows.
Certificeringen: Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate, Azure AI Engineer Associate of vergelijkbaar.

Wat wij bieden

Bouwen vanaf de basis: Je helpt vanaf dag één mee aan het vormgeven van onze dienstverlening.
Technologie: Directe toegang tot de nieuwste Microsoft AI-functionaliteiten, je eigen demo-omgevingen en Copilot-licenties.
Groei: Budget voor certificeringen, trainingen en conferenties.
Flexibiliteit: Hybride werken (minimaal 2 dagen per week op ons kantoor in Amsterdam) met flexibele werktijden.
Netwerk: Een internationaal team in Amsterdam plus het netwerk van de Novature Group.
Levendige teamcultuur: Maak deel uit van een inclusief en hecht team met regelmatige virtuele bijeenkomsten, teamevents en gezamenlijke uitjes.

Solliciteren

Stuur je cv en een paar zinnen over het uitrol- of agent-project waar je het meest trots op bent naar hr@digitalbricks.ai. Een traditionele motivatiebrief is niet nodig.

Wij verwelkomen sollicitaties van iedereen, ongeacht geslacht, achtergrond, leeftijd, religie, beperking of seksuele geaardheid.

Dit ga je doen

Jij test onze web- en system2system-applicaties, die toegang geven tot de digitale rechtspraak. Je bent het kwaliteitsgeweten van je DevOps-team. Werkt de software die we bouwen straks wel goed? Aan welke aspecten is misschien niet gedacht? En hoe controleer je dat? Belangrijke vragen waar jij continu mee bezig bent. Ook overleg je met gebruikers. Want daar doen we het tenslotte allemaal voor. Hoe maken zij gebruik van de systemen in kwestie?

Parallel aan het bouwtraject maak jij een testplan en testscripts, waarbij je uitgangspunt is zo veel mogelijk geautomatiseerd te testen. Je kijkt niet alleen naar de ‘happy flow’, dus als alles volgens plan verloopt. Maar je onderzoekt ook of onze software overeind blijft in onverwachte situaties. Verder maak je scripts om de performance te meten. Met jouw feedback help je je team applicaties op te leveren die hun werk doen. En daar ben je trots op!

jobs.location: Landau in der Pfalz, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
jobs.description:
Role Overview

So arbeiten wir – bitte aufmerksam lesen

Diese Stelle passt nicht zu jedem, und das ist Absicht. Damit du einschätzen kannst, ob sie zu dir passt:

Du baust die Schienen, nicht nur die Züge. Während die anderen KI-Rollen an konkreten Use-Cases arbeiten, verantwortest du das Querschnittliche: Infrastruktur, Frameworks, wiederverwendbare Bausteine, Guardrails. Deine Arbeit zahlt sich darin aus, dass andere schneller und sicherer liefern können.
Effizienz ist dein ständiger Maßstab. KI-Consumption – Token, Compute, API-Kosten – wächst schnell und unbemerkt. Du behältst sie im Blick, triffst fundierte Make-or-Buy-Entscheidungen (lokal vs. Cloud, selbst bauen vs. einkaufen) und kannst sie begründen.
Du wirst öfter "nein" sagen als "ja". Nicht jede schöne Idee braucht eigene Infrastruktur, und nicht jedes Modell muss selbst gehostet werden. Du erkennst, wann der pragmatische Weg der bessere ist – und vertrittst das auch gegenüber begeisterten Kolleginnen und Kollegen.
Jedes Teammitglied handelt sehr autonom. Du setzt dir deinen eigenen Maßstab und prüfst deine eigenen Ergebnisse kritisch, bevor jemand anderes es tut. Austausch und Feedback gibt es selbstverständlich – aber die Qualitätssicherung deiner Arbeit beginnt bei dir.
Du bist der Spezialist für dein Gebiet. Unser Team ist bewusst interdisziplinär aufgestellt, mit kaum Überlappungen zwischen den Disziplinen. Du hast Spezialisten für Frontend, Backend, UX und KI-Anwendungen an deiner Seite – aber Plattform, Betrieb und Effizienz sind dein Feld, und du verantwortest es fachlich selbst.
Wir entwickeln AI-gestützt – konsequent. Tools wie Claude Code oder Cursor sind bei uns Alltag, nicht Experiment. Das verschiebt den Schwerpunkt der Arbeit: weniger Code selbst tippen, mehr Architektur vorgeben und Ergebnisse kritisch prüfen. Du musst nicht jede Zeile selbst geschrieben haben – aber du stehst für jede Zeile gerade, die du ablieferst.
Wöchentliche Freiräume sind fest eingeplant – rund 10 % deiner Arbeitszeit. Zeit für fachliche Weiterentwicklung, eigene Ideen und kreativen Austausch ist bei uns Teil der Arbeitswoche – kein Nice-to-have, das im Tagesgeschäft verdampft.
Ergebnisgetrieben und prozessual schlank. Wir brauchen schnelle, pragmatische Lösungen, die im Alltag funktionieren – keine über Monate ausgefeilten 100%-Systeme. Die Plattform wächst mit den realen Bedürfnissen, nicht mit theoretischen.

Wenn du am produktivsten bist, wenn dir jemand eine fertige Architektur und ein abgestecktes Backlog vorlegt, wirst du bei uns nicht glücklich. Wenn dich reizt, ein Fundament aus dem Nichts zu bauen, auf dem andere aufbauen – dann lies weiter.

Unser Stack

Wir implementieren produktnah überwiegend in C# / .NET. Python nutzen wir, wo es sinnvoll ist – für Prototypen, KI-spezifische Werkzeuge, Datenarbeit und Tooling. Der Schwerpunkt liegt aber klar auf C#. Unsere Frontends bauen wir in React – für diese Rolle kein Muss, aber nützlich. Für KI-Betrieb und -Infrastruktur erwarten wir Vertrautheit mit gängigen Inferenz- und Orchestrierungs-Frameworks sowie mit Containerisierung.

Your Tasks

Die technische Plattform für unsere KI-Anwendungen konzipieren, aufbauen und betreiben: Modell-Hosting, Inferenz, API-Gateways/Routing, wiederverwendbare Bausteine
Lokale / self-hosted LLMs evaluieren, einrichten und betreiben – inklusive Quantisierung, GPU-Dimensionierung und Performance
KI-Consumption und -Kosten transparent machen und aktiv steuern; fundierte Make-or-Buy- und Lokal-vs.-Cloud-Entscheidungen treffen und begründen
Frameworks, Tools und Standards für das Team auswählen und etablieren – Guardrails, die KI-Entwicklung schneller und sicherer machen
Erfolgreiche Prototypen der anderen KI-Rollen in einen tragfähigen, betreibbaren Zustand bringen – bis hin zur Übergabe an R&D oder in den produktiven Betrieb
CI/CD, Monitoring und Betriebsthemen für KI-Lösungen verantworten
Ergebnisse und Empfehlungen gegenüber Fach- und Business-Teams präsentieren – auf dem jeweiligen technischen Niveau deines Gegenübers

Your Profile

Tiefes Veständnis und praktische Erfahrung im Betrieb von KI-/LLM-Anwendungen in einem Unternehmen: Inferenz-Frameworks (z. B. vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp, TGI), API-Gateways/Routing (z. B. LiteLLM), RAG- und Embedding-Infrastruktur
Operative, im Unternehmenskontext angewandte Erfahrung mit lokalen Modellen / Self-Hosting von LLMs – inklusive Quantisierung und Ressourcendimensionierung
Mehrjährige, fundierte praktische Erfahrung innerhalb eines Unternehmens in der Entwicklung von Softwarelösungen, davon ein solider Teil in C# / .NET – mit erkennbarer technischer Tiefe
Erfahrung mit Containerisierung (Docker), CI/CD und Betriebsthemen
Ein waches Auge für Kosten und Effizienz – du kannst KI-Consumption messen, einordnen und optimieren
Gute Übersicht über aktuelle Trends, verfügbare Off-the-shelf-Lösungen und neue Entwicklungen im KI-Umfeld – du weißt, wann man baut und wann man kauft
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Teamsprache ist Deutsch) und gute Englischkenntnisse
Überwiegende Arbeit im Homeoffice, Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Reisen in unser HQ in Landau (ca. 5–10 % der Arbeitszeit)

Must have

Praktische Erfahrung innerhalb eines Unternehmens mit lokalen Modellen / Self-Hosting von LLMs – inklusive Quantisierung und Ressourcendimensionierung
Praktische Erfahrung innerhalb eines Unternehmens im Betrieb von KI-/LLM-Anwendungen: Inferenz-Frameworks (z. B. vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp, TGI), API-Gateways/Routing (z. B. LiteLLM), RAG- und Embedding-Infrastruktur
Erfahrung mit Containerisierung (Docker), CI/CD und Betriebsthemen
Du kannst "nein" sagen, ohne Türen zu schließen und ein Scheitern eingestehen, auch wenn du schon Aufwand investiert hast

Nice to have

Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung oder Anleitung von Entwicklern
Gute Python-Kenntnisse für Tooling und Prototyping
Erfahrung mit Datenaufbereitung und -pipelines (ETL/ELT)
React / moderne Web-Frontends
Erfahrung mit GPU-Infrastruktur und Kostenoptimierung im Cloud-Umfeld

That sounds like you?

Du denkst in Systemen und Fundamenten, nicht nur in einzelnen Lösungen – und baust so, dass andere darauf aufbauen können.
Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Verhältnismäßigkeit – du baust die Infrastruktur, die das Problem braucht, nicht die größtmögliche. Und du erkennst, wann der pragmatische Weg der richtige ist.
Du kannst "nein" sagen, ohne Türen zu schließen – und ein Scheitern eingestehen, auch wenn du schon Aufwand investiert hast.
Du prüfst deine eigenen Ergebnisse kritisch, bevor jemand anderes es tut.
Ein offenes Auge für Defizite und Potenziale, technisch wie organisatorisch

Reasons to become part of AMDT

Transformative Möglichkeiten und integrative Kultur: Werde Teil eines dynamischen, sich weiterentwickelnden Unternehmens, in dem Wachstum gefördert wird, deine Beiträge geschätzt werden und du in einer vielfältigen, unterstützenden Gemeinschaft zusammenarbeiten und dich entfalten kannst.
Flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten: Arbeite so, wie es für dich am besten ist – remote, hybrid oder in unserem hochmodernen Büro.
Zukunftssicherheit: Wir investieren in deine Zukunft und leisten einen Beitrag von 20 % zu einem umfassenden betrieblichen Alterversversongung.
Zusätzliche Krankenversicherung: Genieße zusätzliche Sicherheit mit einer Krankenzusatzversicherung, die dein Wohlbefinden über das Grundlegende hinaus unterstützt.
Unternehmensvorteile: Profitiere von exklusiven Rabatten auf ausgewählte Marken, um deinen Alltag zu bereichern.
Kontinuierliches Lernen: Nutze Preply für einfaches Sprachenlernen und unterstütze so deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung.
Meilensteine feiern: Freue dich über Geschenke zu wichtigen Lebensereignissen wie Heirat, Geburt eines Kindes oder deinem Jubiläum bei uns.

Contact us

Wenn Du Fragen zu der Stelle haben solltest, wende Dich bitte an unser Recruiting-Team (Chiara & Dirk) unter hiring@amdt.com mit Verweis auf den Titel der Stelle

About Us

AMDT is the global market and technology leader for versioning and backup solutions in industrial automation. With its octoplant software platform, the company secures the automation of production processes through strong end-point management, where it consistently records and monitors changes to configurations, programming and project statuses in production. This minimizes downtime, increases efficiency, quality and safety standards, and saves costs as well as resources. As a modular solution, octoplant can be linked to different automation technologies and devices, regardless of the manufacturer.

AMDT was formed in 2022 from the merger of the two established market leaders AUVESY GmbH and MDT Software Inc. The company is headquartered in Landau, Pfalz, Germany, with additional locations in the USA and China. The company works with more than 100 partners on all continents and serves over 3,000 customers worldwide

jobs.description:
Die Aufgabe

Für den weiteren Ausbau unseres SAP-Geschäfts im deutschsprachigen Markt suchen wir einen erfahrenen SAP BTP Architect (m/w/d).
INOMIC mit Sitz in Walldorf baut gemeinsam mit dem internationalen IT- und SAP-Dienstleister Abhiyanta das Geschäft in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz aus. In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die technische Verantwortung für den Aufbau moderner, cloud-nativer Lösungen auf der SAP Business Technology Platform und verbindest dabei fundiertes Architektur-Know-how mit einem klaren Verständnis für Produktdaten- und PLM-Prozesse unserer Kunden.

Deine Verantwortung

Konzeption und technische Architektur von Lösungen auf der SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP)
Design und Umsetzung von Applikationen auf Basis von CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) und RAP (RESTful Application Programming Model)
Definition der End-to-End-Architektur inklusive Integration in SAP S/4HANA- und PLM-Landschaften
Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in tragfähige, skalierbare technische Lösungskonzepte
Fachliche Leitung von Entwicklungsteams und technisches Coaching von Entwicklerinnen und Entwicklern
Durchführung von Architektur-Workshops, technischen Reviews und Kundenpräsentationen auf Entscheider-Ebene
Definition von Standards, Richtlinien und wiederverwendbaren Frameworks für BTP-Entwicklungsprojekte
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den SAP-Consulting- und Delivery-Teams in Deutschland, Indien und Sri Lanka
Unterstützung des Vertriebs bei Presales, Proof-of-Concepts und der technischen Angebotserstellung
Beobachtung neuer SAP-BTP-Technologien und aktive Einbringung in unser Lösungsportfolio

Unser SAP‑BTP- und Technologie-Portfolio

Gesucht wird eine Architektenpersönlichkeit mit Hands-on-Erfahrung, nicht ausschließlich eine konzeptionelle Rolle. Relevante Themen sind unter anderem:
SAP BTP Core & Entwicklung
CAP – Cloud Application Programming Model
RAP – RESTful Application Programming Model
ABAP Cloud / Steampunk-Entwicklung
SAP Fiori Elements und SAPUI5
SAP BTP Services: Integration Suite, Extension Suite, Build Process Automation, Event Mesh
SAP HANA Cloud und Datenmodellierung (CDS Views)
SAP BTP Laufzeitumgebungen: Cloud Foundry und Kyma (Kubernetes)

PLM & Produktdaten
Kenntnisse in PLM-Systemen und -Prozessen (z. B. SAP PLM, Teamcenter, Windchill) und deren Integration mit SAP S/4HANA
Verständnis für Produktdatenmanagement, Stücklisten (BOM) und Engineering-Change-Prozesse
Erfahrung in der Integration von PLM- und ERP-Datenflüssen in produzierenden Unternehmen

Weitere relevante Themen
Identity- und Sicherheitskonzepte auf SAP BTP (Identity Authentication Service, Identity Provisioning Service, Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzepte)
API-Management und Integrationsarchitekturen
DevOps- und CI/CD-Praktiken für BTP-Entwicklungsprojekte
Grundverständnis von SAP Analytics Cloud und Data-&-Analytics-Themen von Vorteil

Dein Profil

Wir suchen eine erfahrene, technisch versierte Persönlichkeit mit nachweisbarem Erfolg in der Konzeption und Umsetzung von SAP-BTP-Lösungen.
Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Architekt bzw. Senior Developer im SAP-BTP-Umfeld
Fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit CAP und RAP
Kenntnisse im Bereich PLM und Produktdatenintegration sind ausdrücklich erwünscht
Erfahrung in der Integration von SAP-BTP-Lösungen mit SAP S/4HANA
Verständnis moderner Cloud-Architekturen (Cloud Foundry, Kyma/Kubernetes)
Erfahrung mit Node.js und/oder Java im Kontext von CAP
SAP-Zertifizierung im Bereich BTP (z. B. SAP Certified Technology Associate) von Vorteil
Ausgeprägte konzeptionelle und analytische Fähigkeiten
Sicheres Auftreten in der Kommunikation mit Fachbereichen, IT und Management
Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen bzw. Nearshore-/Offshore-Delivery-Teams von Vorteil
Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse

Was die Rolle besonders macht

Dies ist keine klassische Architektenrolle in einer bereits vollständig etablierten Organisation.
Du erhältst die Möglichkeit, den technologischen Aufbau unseres SAP-BTP-Portfolios im DACH-Markt von Grund auf mitzugestalten und Standards zu setzen, die zukünftige Projekte prägen.
Dabei kombinieren wir lokale Kundennähe und Architekturverantwortung in Deutschland mit einer skalierbaren SAP- und IT-Delivery-Organisation mit rund 150 Mitarbeitenden in Indien, Dubai und Singapur.

Wie wir Erfolg definieren

Erfolg in dieser Rolle bedeutet, aus Anforderungen tragfähige, skalierbare Architekturen zu machen:
Anforderung → Architekturkonzept → Umsetzung (CAP/RAP) → Stabiler Betrieb → Wiederverwendbare Standards

Was wir bieten

Eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau unseres SAP-BTP-Portfolios im DACH-Markt
Direkter Zugang zu den Managementteams von INOMIC und Abhiyanta
Ein breites SAP-, Data-, Cloud- und Digital-Transformation-Portfolio
Zugriff auf eine skalierbare internationale Delivery-Organisation in Indien, Dubai und Singapur
Weitgehende Freiheit bei der Gestaltung von Architektur- und Technologiestandards
Kurze Entscheidungswege und ein unternehmerisches Umfeld
Attraktives Vergütungspaket mit leistungsbezogenem Anteil
Flexible Arbeitsmodelle in Deutschland und der DACH-Region

Wen wir besonders gerne kennenlernen möchten

Wir suchen erfahrene SAP-BTP-Entwicklerinnen und -Entwickler bzw. Architektinnen und Architekten, die aktuell bei SAP-Beratungshäusern, IT-Dienstleistern, Systemintegratoren oder spezialisierten SAP-Partnern tätig sind und den nächsten unternehmerischen Schritt gehen möchten.
Du kennst CAP und RAP aus eigener Projekterfahrung, verstehst produzierende Unternehmen und ihre PLM-Landschaften und möchtest technische Standards aktiv mitgestalten, statt nur bestehende Konzepte zu verwalten.
Wenn dich das anspricht, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

jobs.title: AI-Native Full-Stack / Backend Engineer (Forward Deployed Engineering)
jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Who we are looking for

📌 This is a future-oriented recruitment process. While we may not have an immediate opening, we're building a network of talented engineers interested in future opportunities with Deloitte. We expect demand to grow in the coming months, so we'd love to get to know great candidates in advance.

We are looking for an experienced AI-native Full-Stack or Backend Engineer
who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with advanced practical experience in AI-assisted and agentic development.

You will work with clients, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders to turn complex and often ambiguous problems into production-ready solutions. AI-native engineering is a core capability of this role
, with AI integrated across the SDLC while maintaining high standards of quality, security, and maintainability.

The role is technology-agnostic. You should be comfortable working across different technology stacks, rapidly understanding unfamiliar systems, and selecting the right approach for the problem.

Core Qualities:

AI-native engineering

You use AI and coding agents as an integral part of software engineering and understand the advanced practices required to make agentic development effective, reliable, and scalable across the SDLC.

Technology-agnostic problem solving

You have strong engineering fundamentals and can quickly become productive across unfamiliar languages, frameworks, platforms, and architectures.

End-to-end ownership

You take responsibility for outcomes across the complete lifecycle — from understanding the business problem and designing the solution to implementation, deployment, and production operation.

Systems thinking

You reason about complete systems, including applications, APIs, data, integrations, infrastructure, security, observability, and operational constraints.

Customer-focused collaboration

You work effectively with clients and multidisciplinary teams, translating ambiguous business needs into practical technical solutions and communicating decisions and trade-offs clearly.

Curiosity and adaptability

You enjoy solving unfamiliar problems, learning new technologies, and continuously improving how software is designed and delivered.

Required experience and engineering capabilities:

Advanced and proven experience designing, leading, and controlling agentic software development as a primary way of delivering complex software.
You should be able to demonstrate how you structure the work of AI coding agents across the SDLC — providing them with the right specifications, context, tools, environments, orchestration, guardrails, and feedback mechanisms — to reliably deliver production-quality software while retaining engineering oversight and accountability.
Approximately 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
, preferably including consulting, client-facing engineering, solution engineering, or similar roles.
Strong backend or full-stack engineering experience
in one or more ecosystems such as Java, C#, Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go, or similar, combined with the ability to work effectively outside a primary technology stack.
Experience designing and delivering APIs, integrations, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and data-intensive applications
.
Strong knowledge of relational and non-relational databases
and experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of software architecture, security, scalability, reliability, performance, and maintainability
.
Hands-on experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, observability, and modern software delivery practices
.
Ability to independently investigate unfamiliar systems
, operate effectively with incomplete or evolving requirements, and rapidly become productive in new technical environments.
Strong problem-solving, client communication, and stakeholder-management skills
, including the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

Additional experience that will help you succeed:

Frontend experience with React, Angular, Vue, or similar frameworks.
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, serverless architectures, microservices, and infrastructure as code.
Knowledge of enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft platforms, Creatio, or comparable systems.
Experience delivering AI agents, copilots, workflow automation, or intelligent enterprise applications.
Familiarity with API management, enterprise integration platforms, event streaming, and advanced observability practices.

Your future role

Own solution delivery end-to-end:
work directly with clients to understand business problems, design solutions, and deliver production-grade applications, services, APIs, integrations, and data solutions.
Apply AI-native engineering across the SDLC:
use advanced agentic development practices to accelerate discovery, design, implementation, testing, review, debugging, documentation, and production support while maintaining engineering quality and security.

Selection process

What you only must do is to take the first step – press the apply button and send us your CV, go through all the stages of the recruitment process:

CV check and then HR screening

Technical interview
with our Architects
Meeting with Business
(optional, depends on case)

Then, last thing to do will be to sign a contract with us. Deloitte is simply your best choice.
🟢

jobs.description:
Company Description

InPost Group is an innovative European out of home deliveries company, revolutionizing the way parcels are delivered to customers. With operations across several countries, our network of intelligent lockers provides customers with a fast, convenient, and secure delivery option. InPost Group is a publicly traded company, with a market capitalization of about $5 billion as of March 2023. With over 10,000 people worldwide, InPost Group is one of the largest out of home delivery providers in Europe, committed to providing sustainable and efficient delivery solutions to meet the evolving needs of customers in today's rapidly changing landscape.

We are a team that builds the best FMCG e-commerce in Poland.
We already have over 300,000 products
in our offer, we work with over 300 sellers
, and our mobile application has already been downloaded by almost 1.5 million users in Poland
. Due to the fact that our product consists of many elements that must work together efficiently and be managed effectively, we are looking for experienced consumer-focused (Web / Mobile App products) engineering leaders to join us in that journey
- heavily influence our future platform build, improve processes and help us deliver best customer experience in the market across all types of devices.

Job Description

jobs.title: Software Engineer in Test (6 months contract)
jobs.description:
Job Description

About this role:

A Software Engineer in Test (SET)
, is a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), is a hybrid role that combines the responsibilities of a software developer with the expertise of a quality assurance (QA) tester. They are integral to ensuring the quality and reliability of software products by designing and developing automated testing solutions

As a part of R&D Department at Altium, you will be responsible for maintaining and improving existing testing infrastructure along with creating new test frameworks from scratch and You'll be participating in building test platforms to support software engineering. You will be involved in a wide range of automation activities to support the fast development of new features of Altium cloud products. As a Software Engineer, you will work together with an ambitious team of professionals.

A day in the life of our Software Engineer in Test:

Design and development of test automation: Create, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and test scripts to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
Collaboration: Work closely with software developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand features, technical implementations, and testing requirements.
Testing execution and analysis: Execute both automated and manual tests (functional, non-functional, regression, performance, security), analyze results, and provide detailed reports.
Integration with development lifecycle: Integrate testing processes into the CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment) pipelines and Agile methodologies.
Process improvement: Participate in code reviews, recommend corrective actions, and continuously improve testing practices, tools, and processes
Knowledge and experience with at least one of OOP languages: C# (preferable), Java, Python; the willingness of programming in C# as main technology required;
Experience with test tools, standards and frameworks such as Selenium WebDriver, SpecFlow/Reqnroll, NUnit, Fiddler, HTTP Debugger etc.
Understanding of Cloud computing solutions (AWS, Alibaba), containerization and virtualization
Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, Gitlab) and Git;
Experience with Grafana and test automation reporting tools (eg. Allure);
At least base understanding REST-based and GraphQL API technologies
Collaboration: Work closely with developers, product managers, and QA to understand requirements and ensure testability.
CI/SD Integration: Integrate automated tests into Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery pipeline (e.g. Jenkins)
Process Improvement: Continuously improve testing processes, tools, and methodologies

Qualifications

Who We’re Looking For

Experience with performance testing process, performance testing tools (eg. Nbomber, Jmeter, Locus, K6 etc.), tools and techniques for performance measurement, profiling, and optimization;
DB basic knowledge (MySQL, Firebird);
Playwright experience - big plus
+4 years of experience in test automation or software development
English communication skills (written & verbal) required

Additional Information

Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development.

From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

jobs.description:
Who We Are Looking For

We are seeking a smart, experienced, and talented individual that takes a service-oriented approach to their work and is passionate about software development and process automation. In this role you will work as part of an agile team of software developers and systems engineers responsible for building, supporting, and enhancing the feature set of our cloud-native technology stack.

Current skills using programming languages/tools for our active code bases are required. These include both Python, and Java ecosystems, web development in Windows and Linux environments.

Proficiency in developing with SQL Server databases is key to this role and strong skills are required.

Candidates must be able to demonstrate proficiency with Git and modern CI/CD software engineering practices.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Development of new processes, services and applications using modern software development languages, tools, and methodologies
Automation, configuration, monitoring and troubleshooting of cloud-based Linux and Windows systems
Collaborate with geographically dispersed, cross-functional teams to streamline workflows
Support business users with technical issues
Identify root causes for technical problems and continuously refine our infrastructure
Define and document workflows and operating procedures for complex systems

What We Value

A successful candidate will be a technical hands-on lead, eager to learn new technologies, skilled in using modern software development tools, familiar with automation techniques, and exceptional at helping people find innovative solutions to challenging problems.
This job is an excellent fit for someone eager to make key contributions in our fast-paced, ever-evolving environment who has a passion for quality, problem solving, and good attention to detail.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

5+ years experience using Sequentum to scrape web content
5+ years experience developing automated extraction of product and pricing information from retailer web sites
multiple years of experience leading a large scale web scraping operation
ability to effectively work with retailer sites in the native languages of 30+ economies across the globe
ability to train and mentor junior developers in scraping technologies, techniques, and policies every few months as new cohorts join the team
highly proficient in English (minimum C-level), with the ability to lead cross-functional collaboration, build strong stakeholder relationships, and drive clear, effective communication across APAC, EMEA, North America, and South America to achieve global business objectives
Master's degree in computer science or information technology (or similar) or equivalent experience
min. 4 years of experience writing software in Python and Java ecosystems (Spring, Maven, JUnit)
min. 4 years of experience with web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, JSON, XML)
experience developing with MS SQL Server databases
familiarity with Linux (bash) and Windows environments (PowerShell)
experience building and deploying systems using Amazon Web Services (AWS)
Proficient with modern software development tools (IDEs, CI/CD, GIT, Jira, Confluence, etc.) and agile (scrum) management practices.

Note:

zł182,004 Annual

Att jobba som .NET-utvecklare

Som .NET-utvecklare blir du en del av vårt Open Banking-team, där du utvecklar moderna lösningar som möjliggör säker och smidig integration mellan banker, fintechbolag och andra externa aktörer.

Tyngdpunkten i rollen ligger på backendutveckling, men du kommer även att arbeta med frontend. Rollen passar dig som vill arbeta med både nyutveckling och vidareutveckling i ett område som är i ständig förändring.

utveckla och vidareutveckla backendtjänster i .NET
bygga och förvalta API och integrationer mot externa aktörer

jobs.title: Software Engineer / AI Engineer
jobs.description:
We're growing our engineering team and looking for both Software Engineers and AI Engineers to help build the next generation of Aleido's platform. Whether your strength is solid, scalable software or applying AI to real products, you'll join a team where AI isn't a side project. It's built into what we deliver and how we build it.

About The Role

You'll work on Aleido's modular platform for product information, used by some of the world's leading industrial companies to create, manage and deliver technical content. You'll own work from specification to deployment, contribute to technical decisions and help shape how we engineer as a team.

You'll join us in one of two directions:

As a Software Engineer, you'll focus on building high-quality features across the platform: APIs, cloud services and modular architecture on Azure and .NET.
As an AI Engineer, you'll focus on bringing AI into the platform and our products: LLM-powered features, agent integrations, automation and tooling that turns AI capabilities into measurable customer value.

Both directions share the same foundation and work closely together.

What You'll Do

Own development tasks from specification to deployment.
Write high-quality, scalable and maintainable code, using AI-assisted development to work faster without compromising quality.
Contribute to design and architecture discussions and propose technical solutions.
Perform thorough code reviews and contrubute to overall code validation and quality practices.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners and UX to refine requirements.
Support platform operations, monitoring and troubleshooting.
Improve workflows, documentation and engineering standards, including how we work with AI.
Stay curious about new technologies and help keep our solutions ahead of the curve.

Who You Are

We believe that you have:

A strong understanding of software engineering, cloud services and distributed systems.
Good experience with Azure, .NET or an equivalent modern tech stack.
An understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and observability.
A clear grasp of API design, modular architecture and platform patterns.
Hands-on experience using AI tools in your development work, and genuine interest in where this technology is heading.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, and a sense of ownership for what you deliver.
Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Fluency in English, written and spoken.

For the AI Engineer direction, we also expect experience building with LLMs, AI services or frameworks (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI or Azure AI services), and with integrating AI capabilities into .NET applications.

Nice to have

Experience with Azure cloud platform.
Familiarity of AI/ML-enabled systems, including information flow, uncertainty and error propagation, common failure modes, and approaches to troubleshooting and debugging.
Experience with agentic workflows, MCP or other AI integration patterns.
Understanding of business process mapping and optimization techniques.
Familiarity with content management, technical documentation or aftermarket information.

Who We Are

Aleido is a Swedish international company with a long heritage of driving the development of product information and learning solutions. Our customers develop complex products or systems, or seek knowledge and confidence to create lasting change, within a wide range of industries including automotive, telecom, advanced machinery, rail and medtech. We are almost a thousand colleagues in five countries. Together we bridge the gap between technology and the people who depend on it – by making the advanced simply understood.

You'll be part of a tight-knit and innovative team where your work truly makes a difference. We believe in empowering people, embracing creativity and constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible with software and AI.

jobs.description:
Job Title

Software Developer for AXIS Body Worn in Linköping

Job Description

Are you an Experienced Software Developer
who thrives in close collaboration and takes pride in delivering quality? AXIS Body Worn is a growing business area, and we're looking for a developer to join our team in Linköping where you'll help shape wearable camera solutions designed for professionals who rely on them in critical, real-world situations.

Who is your future team?

The AXIS Body Worn organization in Linköping consists of several teams working together to develop and evolve the Body Worn product portfolio. The team you would be joining is a group of 5-6 experienced developers who share a strong sense of ownership and collaboration. Together, you take end-to-end responsibility for your product, from defining it alongside product management, through development and testing, all the way to release. You work closely with each other, sharing tasks and solving problems as one unit.

Our R&D site in Linköping is still growing, which means short distances between people, easy collaboration across teams, and a real chance to influence how we work and what we build.

What You'll Do Here As a Software Developer

As a developer you play a key role in building and evolving products that integrate body worn cameras into the broader Axis ecosystem. Your work directly impacts how customers experience and use our solutions.

Develop, test, and deploy software as part of the full product lifecycle
Analyze customer needs and translate them into well-designed solutions
Collaborate closely with product management to define and shape the product
Drive integration of AXIS Body Worn with other products in the Axis ecosystem
Communicate and coordinate with other development teams and stakeholders
Contribute to continuous improvement of development practices and quality
Explore and apply new approaches, including AI and agentic development, to accelerate delivery

Who are you?

We're looking for someone who values collaboration and open communication, someone who enjoys working closely with colleagues, sharing tasks, and taking collective ownership of a product. You are self-driven, curious, and quality-minded. You care deeply about building software that truly works for the people who use it.

In this team, how you work and who you are matters more than a specific list of technologies. You bring experience from product development and are comfortable contributing across the full development cycle.

We'd love to hear that you have:

Experience building and releasing software products
A Master of Science in Engineering, or similar
Working knowledge of Go and/or TypeScript
Familiarity with C# and .NET

Bonus points for:

Experience with similar product types, such as wearable or embedded devices
Familiarity with pair and ensemble programming

What Axis has to offer:   

This position is based in Linköping, primarily on-site at our office in Ebbepark. Our work environment fosters teamwork and innovation, with plenty of room for fun! Together, we enjoy activities like table tennis, Mario Kart, or a game of pickleball at Campushallen.

Axis is a company that realizes the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. 

Ready to Act?  

Find out more from Engineering manager Rickard Hermansson at +46 (0)70 847 00 21 or HR-Generalist Hannah Skog at +46 (0)76 176 24 94.

jobs.description:
Etteplan är ett internationellt teknikkonsultbolag med över 4000 specialister globalt. I Sverige arbetar vi nära våra kunder i tekniskt komplexa, ofta långsiktiga uppdrag där mjukvara är affärskritisk. Vi hjälper marknadsledande industriföretag inom exempelvis flyg, fordon, försvar och industriella system att utveckla robusta och framtidssäkra lösningar – i miljöer där kvalitet, tillförlitlighet och ingenjörsmässighet är avgörande. Hos oss är tekniken avancerad, men samarbetet är prestigelöst. Vi tror på tydlighet, förtroende och på kraften i erfarna team som tar ansvar tillsammans.

Vi samarbetar mellan våra kontor och anställer där kompetensen finns. Därför är du välkommen att söka även om du bor på en annan ort än den som anges i annonsen, förutsatt att du kan arbeta från något av våra kontor.

Din roll

Som Mjukvaruutvecklare / Embedded Software
på Etteplan arbetar du i uppdrag där mjukvaran är en central del av helheten – ofta i system med höga krav på stabilitet, säkerhet och livslängd. Projekten kan omfatta allt från låg- och mellanlagernära utveckling till mer systemövergripande ansvar, beroende på din erfarenhet och kundens behov.

Du arbetar nära andra ingenjörsdiscipliner och har en viktig roll i att omsätta krav till hållbara tekniska lösningar. I många uppdrag förväntas du bidra med mer än bara kod – exempelvis genom tekniska resonemang, struktur, mentorskap eller ett helhetsperspektiv på systemet. För dig som vill finns också möjlighet att ta tekniskt ledande ansvar.

Vi rekryterar till flera av våra kontor runt om i Sverige och arbetar huvudsakligen regionalt, med hybridarbete där uppdraget tillåter.

Din profil

För att kunna möta våra kunders behov ser vi att du:

Har ingenjörsutbildning inom datateknik, inbyggda system, elektronik eller motsvarande
Har 3+ års relevant yrkeserfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling, gärna inom embedded
Har god erfarenhet av C/C++, C#, Python och arbete i Linux‑miljö
Är van att arbeta enligt agila arbetssätt och etablerade utvecklingsprocesser
Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift

Det meriterande om du har erfarenhet eller kunskap inom AI, automatiserade byggen och testning, systemsäkerhet eller functional safety.

Många av våra uppdrag bedrivs i reglerade eller säkerhetsklassade miljöer, vilket ställer krav på struktur, dokumentation och professionell kommunikation. Därför söker vi dig som är trygg i din kompetens, arbetar metodiskt och tar ansvar för kvalitet i leveransen. Tjänsten kan innebära säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagstiftning, och för vissa uppdrag krävs svenskt medborgarskap.

Att vara konsult hos Etteplan

Som konsult hos Etteplan får du kombinera stabiliteten hos en etablerad arbetsgivare med variationen i olika uppdrag, tekniker och branscher. Du blir en del av ett erfaret ingenjörsnätverk där kunskapsdelning, långsiktighet och kvalitet står i fokus.

Vi erbjuder

Hos Etteplan erbjuder vi trygga anställningsvillkor med kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, försäkringar, vårdförsäkring och friskvårdsbidrag. Du får en flexibel arbetsmiljö med möjlighet till hybridarbete samt stöd från erfarna kollegor och närvarande konsultchefer. Vi värnar om balans i livet och skapar förutsättningar för både professionell och personlig utveckling.

Ansökan och nästa steg

Ansök genom att ladda upp ditt CV och besvara några korta urvalsfrågor. Processen inleds med en telefonavstämning och följs av samtal med konsultchef och vid behov tekniska kollegor.

Overview
We’re looking for 3 experienced Java Developers with strong hands-on Keycloak and Identity & Access Management experience to develop and support secure, scalable backend applications and authentication services.

This assignment combines Java backend development with identity security, working across microservices, API security and authentication integrations.

Develop and maintain backend applications and microservices using Java and Spring Boot.
Configure, integrate and support Keycloak in production environments.

5+ years of commercial Java development experience, including Java 11/17+.

Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT and SAML.
Experience developing secure REST APIs, microservices and distributed applications.
Practical knowledge of SSO, RBAC, MFA and identity federation.
Experience with PostgreSQL, Oracle or MySQL.

Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Company

A specialist in identity, secure transactions, and digital services, IN Groupe is the global leader in secure identity and trust services. Every day, our 4,000 employees across 40 countries work to ensure that everyone has access to a reliable and secure identity, both in the physical and digital worlds. With our solutions and our international network of 10 R&D centers, we support governments and businesses in more than 130 countries.

Joining IN Groupe means helping to shape the future of the identity and secure transaction market. Become part of our international teams — driven by innovation and proud to design solutions that make life easier and protect personal data for millions of people around the world.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior backend engineer to join our Stockholm office
with strong, hands‑on expertise in modern Java,
experienced in building and maintaining distributed systems and microservices. Brings solid proficiency in CI/CD and Azure DevOps
(or comparable platforms), along with practical knowledge of cloud environments, containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, automated testing practices, and operating services reliably in production.

Main Responsibilities

Focus on backend development, with responsibility for services, databases, and system integrations.
Develop, improve, and maintain services with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
Select and use technologies based on problem-solving value, not trendiness.
Ensure that deliveries are on time and secure, always balancing speed with quality.
Collaborate closely with teammates and stakeholders, enabling fast and sustainable delivery.
Over time, take a leading role in driving improvements in both technology and ways of working.

Our Tech Stack (key areas for this role)

Java (primary language: deep expertise required)
Spring Boot
REST, Microservices, Databases
Azure (cloud environment), Docker, Kubernetes

About You

Highly experienced in backend Java development and proficient with Azure.
Results-oriented: you deliver what is needed, when it is needed.
Pragmatic: you enjoy new technology but choose what best solves the current problem while limiting technical debt.
Humble and grounded: you listen, collaborate, and keep the team's health in mind.
Independent yet collaborative: you take initiative but thrive in teamwork.
User-focused: the end user's experience is always your guiding star.

Qualifications

Extensive experience in Java backend development (main requirement).
Experience with Spring Boot and modern development practices.
Solid understanding of Microservices and integrations.
Professional proficiency in English.

What We Offer

Impactful work: Your code directly powers secure identity services used by real customers worldwide.
A pragmatic environment: We value smart choices over shiny tools. You'll use the most adapted technologies to solve problems, reduce complexity, and limit future technical debt.
A healthy team culture: We believe in humility, collaboration, and keeping team well-being in balance with delivery goals.
End-to-end responsibility: You'll see the whole lifecycle, from development through deployment to customer use.
Growth into leadership: Over time, you'll have the opportunity to take on a bigger role in driving initiatives and supporting others in the team.

Har ingenjörsutbildning inom datateknik, inbyggda system, elektronik eller motsvarande

jobs.title: Cloud Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Att välja Capgemini innebär att välja en arbetsplats där du ges möjlighet att forma din karriär på det sätt du själv önskar, där du ingår i en stödjande och inspirerande gemenskap med engagerade kollegor världen över, och där du får chansen att omdefiniera vad som är möjligt. Våra Cloud & Custom Applications team fokuserar på att utveckla skräddarsydda, skalbara och säkra cloudapplikationer, integrera IT-system och driva affärstransformation. AI är en nyckelteknologi i allt vi gör och en central del i hur vi formar och bygger moderna system och lösningar, där intelligenta AI-drivna arbetssätt och teknologier som Agentic AI driver utvecklingen framåt. Bli en del av oss och var med och forma framtidens system tillsammans med världsledande organisationer och bidra till att frigöra teknikens fulla potential i en mer hållbar och inkluderande värld!

Om rollen

Är du passionerad kring allt som rör molnet? Vi söker just nu en erfaren Cloud Solution Architect till vårt Architecture & BA-team i Malmö/Helsingborg. Teamet fokuserar på arkitektur, utveckling samt att bygga lösningar och tjänster på två av de största molnplattformarna – AWS och GCP. Du kommer att arbeta med kunduppdrag i Skåne-regionen, men som en del av Capgeminis globala organisation får du även möjlighet att samarbeta, utvecklas och växa tillsammans med kollegor världen över.

Teamet arbetar med att skapa moderna, skalbara och hållbara lösningar i molnet – alltid med kundens affär i fokus. Med både bredd och djup erbjuder vi fantastiska möjligheter att förädla dina arkitekturfärdigheter, dela kunskap och utveckla dig tillsammans med skickliga kollegor i teamet.

I den här rollen kommer du att ha en nyckelroll i:

Arbeta med applikationsdesign och arkitektur i molnmiljöer
Integrationer för molnbaserade tjänster
Cloud DevOps och DevSecOps samt Lösningsarkitektur
DevOps verktyg; Git, Docker, Maven, Kubernetes

Din profil

+5 års erfarenhet av utveckling i tekniker så som Java, J2EE, Node.js, och React
Du har hands on erfarenhet inom AWS eller GCP och kan bevisa det med motsvarande certifiering
Goda kunskaper av Mikrotjänster - Utveckling och distribution av mikrotjänster i molnet inklusive containerisering, orkestrering och infrastruktur som kod med hjälp av Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, BlackDuck, samt +2 års dokumenterade erfarenhet av att designa/implementera AI/ML-lösningar, med fokus på maskininlärning, djupinlärning, NLP och GenAI
Du skriver och talar flytande svenska då det används i det dagliga arbetet

Meriterande

Back-end erfarenhet inom följande: Python, TypeScript eller liknande
Front-end erfarenhet inom följande: Angular, Vue.js eller Jquery

Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas

Arbeta med de senaste teknologierna och påverka på nordisk nivå. Du samarbetar med andra specialister, kompetensväxlar och bidrar till att bygga AWS/GCP-kapabilitet i Norden – samtidigt som du påverkar några av världens största bolag.
Utvecklas genom utbildningar, certifieringar och interna initiativ. Du får tillgång till utbildningar och certifieringar inom AI, AWS/GCP och Microsoft Azure, samt möjlighet att engagera dig i Capgeminis fokusområden som Diversity & Inclusion, Sustainability, Wellness Club och Art Club.
Njut av en engagerande arbetsplats med starkt stöd och förmåner. Vi erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension, bonusprogram, företagshälsovård och sjukvårdsförsäkring samt en inkluderande kontorskultur med sociala aktiviteter och teambuilding.

Ansökan

Redo att ta din karriär till nästa nivå? Vi ser fram emot din ansökan och återkommer till dig så snart som möjligt.

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov.

Om Capgemini

Capgemini är en AI-driven global partner för affärs- och tekniktransformation som levererar konkret verksamhetsnytta. Vi formar framtiden för organisationer och förverkligar den med hjälp av AI, teknik och människor. Med vår starka historia på nästan 60 år är vi en ansvarsfull och mångsidig koncern med över 420 000 medarbetare i över 50 länder. Genom vår expertis inom strategi, teknik, design, ingenjörstjänster och affärsverksamhet levererar vi heltäckande tjänster och lösningar, baserade på vår djupa branschkunskap och vårt omfattande partnernätverk. Koncernen rapporterade globala intäkter på 22,5 miljarder euro för 2025.

Make it real | www.capgemini.com

Join a high-calibre engineering team working on next-generation technology

Your role at Clorox:

The Integration & HyperAutomation Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and supporting enterprise integrations and intelligent automations that enable business process transformation, operational efficiency, and digital innovation. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with expertise in APIs, integrations, robotic process automation (RPA), workflow automation, and AI-enabled automation capabilities. The engineer partners closely with Solution Architects, Product Owners, Technical Leads, Business Analysts, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders to implement secure, reliable, and reusable solutions that connect applications, data, and business processes across the enterprise.

In this role, you will:

This role sits at the centre of Clorox's digital transformation agenda. The Integration & HyperAutomation Engineer helps the business operate faster, smarter, and more efficiently by connecting enterprise systems and automating complex business processes. Through enterprise integrations, APIs, robotic process automation (RPA), and AI-enabled solutions, this position directly contributes to productivity improvements, scalability, and innovation across the organisation.

The successful candidate will design, build, and support enterprise integrations using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform and intelligent automations using UiPath. They will work with business and technology teams to create secure, scalable solutions that connect applications, data, and workflows across functions such as Finance, HR, Sales, Marketing, and Operations.

Key areas of focus include:

Building and managing APIs and enterprise integrations
Developing intelligent automation and RPA solutions
Leveraging AI services to enhance business processes
Supporting enterprise-wide digital transformation initiatives
Creating reusable assets and frameworks that accelerate future delivery

Key selling points:

Opportunity to work on high-impact enterprise transformation initiatives
Exposure to cutting-edge technologies including Generative AI, Agentic AI, intelligent automation, and API-led architectures
Ability to influence how business processes are modernised across a global organisation
Strong cross-functional visibility, partnering with architects, product teams, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and business leaders
Excellent platform for career growth in integration engineering, automation, and AI-driven technology solutions
Opportunity to gain or utilise highly sought-after certifications in MuleSoft and UiPath

This role is a key enabler of Clorox's digital transformation strategy, helping the company become more connected, automated, and AI-enabled. By building enterprise integrations and intelligent automations, the engineer reduces manual effort, improves data flow across systems, accelerates business processes, and enables teams to focus on higher-value work.

The successful hire will:

Drive operational efficiency by automating repetitive processes and eliminating manual handoffs.
Accelerate business transformation through API-led connectivity and intelligent workflow orchestration.
Improve business agility by enabling faster integration of new applications, platforms, and technologies.
Enhance employee productivity through automation and AI-powered solutions.
Strengthen enterprise scalability by creating reusable integration and automation assets that can be leveraged across multiple business functions.
Support AI adoption by connecting enterprise systems and data that serve as the foundation for future AI and agentic capabilities.
Reduce risk and improve reliability through secure, governed, and resilient integration architecture.

3-5+ years of software development, integration, or automation experience
Hands-on expertise with MuleSoft and/or UiPath
Strong API development and integration experience
Experience with cloud and enterprise platforms such as SAP, ServiceNow, Workday, Azure, or Power Platform

Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.

Why IBM Ireland?

🔹 Innovate with Impact: Be at the forefront of technological innovation, developing backend services and APIs that power our world-class AI-infused management features.

🔹 Collaborate & Thrive: Work alongside industry-leading Architects, AI Experts, Product Managers, DevOps Engineers, and Test Automation Engineers in a dynamic, multi-disciplinary environment that fosters creativity and teamwork.

🔹 Endless Growth Opportunities: With our global reach and commitment to innovation, IBM Ireland is the perfect place to advance your career and explore new possibilities. Our doors are always open for those eager to learn and grow!

🔹 Developer Academy: Created to provide a foundation for new hires starting their journey as an enterprise developer at IBM Software. Over one-week intensive journey, developers are introduced to the devops mindset, Agile philosophy, cloud deployment models and basic Git concepts

Your Role And Responsibilities

This is a 6- or 9-month placement opportunity designed for students completing a placement year as part of their degree.

Start date: January - March 2027
Duration: 6 or 9 months
Working model: Hybrid

As part of our hybrid working model, you'll be expected to work from our Mulhuddart Campus three days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely in line with team requirements.

What Makes You a Great Fit

Tech Savvy

You have a basic understanding of one or more programming languages or technologies such as Java, Python, JavaScript, Rust, C/C++, Go, or similar, along with an interest in AI, Cloud Engineering, CI/CD, Test Automation, and software development methodologies.

This placement is designed to help you develop your technical skills, gain hands-on experience, and learn from experienced IBM professionals.

Growth Minded

You thrive in environments where learning never stops. You enjoy learning from others, sharing knowledge, and continuously developing new skills and technologies alongside your colleagues.

Self-Starter

You're a proactive problem-solver who takes initiative, embraces new challenges, and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

What Are the Opportunities in IBM Ireland?

As An Intern Developer At IBM Ireland, You'll Have The Opportunity To Learn, Grow, And Contribute Across a Variety Of Areas, Including

Backend Development

Design and build robust microservices and APIs while helping shape the next generation of hybrid cloud management solutions.

Frontend Development

Create engaging user experiences and help solve design and usability challenges through creative problem-solving.

DevOps & Platform Engineering

Work at the heart of our technology ecosystem, supporting the automation and continuous improvement of development and operational processes. This is a great opportunity to learn about DevOps, CI/CD, cloud technologies, and modern software delivery practices while helping teams build, test, and deliver software more efficiently.

Quality Engineering

If you have a keen eye for detail and enjoy problem-solving, you'll have opportunities to help ensure the quality and reliability of software while developing valuable testing and automation skills.

jobs.title: Sr Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?

At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.

Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

Summary

At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.

Sequencing has moved genomics from single studies to population scale. Multi-million-sample cohorts, linked phenotypes and multi-omic data are now generated faster than most organizations can analyze them. Our team builds the data platform and the analytical applications that turn these assets into products: a cloud-native lakehouse for genomic and phenotypic data, large-scale statistical genetics pipelines that run reliably at population scale, and the APIs and user interfaces that let scientists ask questions of billions of records and get answers in seconds.

We are looking for a Sr. Staff Software Engineer for this effort in Singapore: someone who can take state-of-the-art analytical methods and turn them into scalable, high-performance, commercial software, and who can work fluently across bioinformatics scientists, cloud infrastructure engineers, and product management. You will work with a globally distributed team, prototyping quickly, demonstrating early, and iterating toward a releasable product.

Responsibilities

Turn advanced statistical genetics methods (for example, genome-wide and phenome-wide association testing for both common and rare variants) from prototypes into high-performance, scientifically accurate, commercially releasable products.
Design and implement analysis pipelines that scale to millions of samples on a cloud-native lakehouse, and establish the standardized, reusable design pattern for low-latency analysis on open table formats at petabyte scale.
Deliver the APIs, web UI and natural-language/agentic query interfaces through which scientific users explore association results and cohort/phenotype data interactively at scale.
Own the operability and unit economics of the platform: orchestrate, monitor, debug and cost-optimize workloads spanning millions of concurrent jobs, designing for fault tolerance and reproducible results.
Partner with bioinformatics scientists, cloud infrastructure teams and product management to translate scientific and customer needs into a product architecture and credible delivery plan aligned with the platform and data business strategy, applying a clear view of what distinguishes a commercial-grade offering from research and open-source community tooling.
Set technical direction and raise engineering standards through design review, mentorship and hands-on contribution, prototyping and iterating rapidly with a customer-first mindset across a globally distributed team.

Requirements

Degree in Computer Science / Engineering / Bioinformatics / Mathematics or a related field.
Demonstrated experience designing and delivering large-scale, data-analysis production software in the cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including containerization (Docker), orchestration, infrastructure automation, and CI/CD.
Strong experience with modern data lake / lakehouse architectures, including open table format internals rather than usage alone: Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake table specifications, catalog services, snapshot lifecycle, partitioning and pruning strategy, compaction, and schema evolution, over columnar storage (Parquet) with distributed query engines (for example Spark, Trino, Databricks).
Solid algorithms and systems engineering foundation, with proven ability to implement performance-critical code in a compiled language such as C/C++, including concurrency, memory management, vectorization and SIMD, and work with columnar in-memory formats and vectorized engines such as Apache Arrow, DuckDB, or Velox.
Proven track record of profiling and optimizing end-to-end systems for runtime, memory, I/O and cloud cost at large scale, and of designing for horizontal scalability.
Proficiency in Python for rapid prototyping, data analysis, and productionized tooling, with familiarity with the scientific and ML/DL library ecosystem.
Experience designing and operating distributed batch and workflow systems that manage very large numbers of concurrent jobs, including metrics, tracing and structured logging, retry, checkpointing and idempotency, and failure triage at million-task scale.
Experience with scientific workflow languages and engines (for example Nextflow, WDL, CWL) and with execution on cloud batch or Kubernetes.
Experience designing and delivering service APIs with an API-first approach: REST or gRPC interface design, versioning and backward compatibility, and multi-tenant access patterns; plus enough full-stack fluency to partner on (or build) modern web front ends and to hold strong opinions on UI/UX for data-heavy scientific applications.
Experience validating numerically and statistically sensitive software: concordance testing against reference implementations, calibration checks, benchmark suites, versioned reference data, and end-to-end reproducibility.
Proven technical leadership and influence at senior level, with strong verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to self-manage and manage interdisciplinary relationships.
Demonstrated experience using AI tooling to plan, manage and accelerate the full software development lifecycle, and to materially increase engineering productivity and quality.

Experience / Education

Sr. Staff Software Engineer: Typically requires a minimum of 12 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 8 years and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 5 years experience; or equivalent experience.

Desired

Working knowledge of statistical genetics and population genomics: genome-wide and phenome-wide association studies, common and rare variant analysis (including gene-based burden and aggregate tests), mixed-model and whole-genome regression approaches, and the standard data formats and quality control practices of the field (VCF/gVCF, PLINK, BGEN, summary statistics, cohort and phenotype definition, ancestry and relatedness handling).
Hands-on experience with genomics-native storage and query stacks such as TileDB / TileDB-VCF, Hail, GLOW, or GenomicsDB.
Experience delivering commercial or clinical-grade genomics or life-science data products, including taking an internal or research tool through to a commercially released product, and a clear understanding of the differences in philosophy, obligations and trade-offs between commercial productization and academic, non-profit or research-community tooling.
Familiarity with techniques for low-latency query over very large result sets: precomputed summary indices, bitmap and zone maps, sketching, and tiered materialization.
Experience building agentic workflows and products, including tool/agent orchestration and MCP-style integrations, over enterprise data; and with machine learning, deep learning or foundation model training applied to genomic or biomedical data.
Experience implementing data governance controls: role-based and row/column-level access, audit trails, tenant isolation, and consent-driven restrictions on data use.
Experience with interactive data visualization for very large result sets, and with modern front-end frameworks.
Cloud cost engineering: cost-per-analysis modelling, spot and preemptible capacity strategy, storage tiering, and egress management.
Be curious, detail oriented, and analytical, with a proven ability to learn quickly.
Be customer-focused, team-oriented, and motivated, taking ownership of assigned tasks and of ambiguous problems.

Listed responsibilities are an essential, but not exhaustive, list of the usual duties associated with the position. Changes to individual responsibilities may occur due to business needs.

Join our mission to grow and transform the subscription economy by simplifying subscription service delivery.

Infiterra
enables IT distributors, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and telcos to succeed in the subscription economy. Our subscription commerce platform automates and unifies subscription workflows - from quote to bill- driving operational efficiency, billing accuracy, and scalable growth.

Recognized as a global leader in subscription commerce, Infiterra combines innovation, performance excellence, and trusted expertise to help partners transform and grow.

Join Infiterra and help power the future of subscription e-commerce.

Infiterra’s B2B SaaS platform helps IT Distributors and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) automate and grow their subscription business. With 100+ customers in 75 countries, we're recognized for innovation and global impact—and we’re just getting started. We foster a collaborative and growth-oriented culture, allowing you to be part of a dynamic, forward-thinking team.

The role in a nutshell 🔍

As a .NET Software Engineer, you'll be part of our agile team, working in the Scrum framework to deliver new features and improve existing ones in our subscription e-commerce platform, the multi-tenant B2B engine that powers global distributors. You'll own whole features within a product domain, from design to production, and work alongside experienced engineers who'll support your growth. From building scalable services to integrating major Software Vendors with our platform, your work will directly shape what our customers use every day.

🎯 Your goal?

To design and deliver reliable, well-tested features that simplify subscription services delivery, following our coding and architectural standards.

You'll be hands-on with .NET (legacy full .NET Framework 4.8 and .NET 10 (latest)), C#, SQL, and domain and service-oriented approaches. You'll work closely with POs, BAs, QA, and DevOps in an agile environment, so that features are delivered smoothly and predictably.

You won’t just code features. You'll own your features end-to-end: design, build, test, release, and keep them healthy in production.

🙋‍♀️ Our Ideal Candidate Profile

You’re a curious and analytical engineer who sees the big picture but sweats the details. You enjoy diving into system architecture, making thoughtful trade-offs, and writing clean, testable code.

You thrive in a fast-paced environment where innovation meets stability. You’re not just a builder. You’re a problem solver who looks for ways to make systems more efficient, scalable, and maintainable.

You value teamwork and knowledge-sharing, but you’re also confident in owning features independently. You’re someone who wants to grow while helping the team grow.

Why You’ll Love It Here 💙

Work on a platform that directly impacts customers across 75+ countries.
Hands-on exposure to APIs, billing systems, and large-scale/high-traffic B2B commerce.
A collaborative engineering culture with peer-led code reviews and knowledge-sharing.
Opportunities to shape system architecture and technical direction.
Friendly, dynamic team with room to grow and learn.

What You'll Do

Feature Ownership: Own the end-to-end delivery of whole features within a domain, designing and delivering them independently to our coding and architectural standards.
Technical Debt: Manage your own technical debt through refactoring.
Automated Testing: Write robust automated tests.
Code Reviews: Review your peers' pull requests.
Observability: Build observability into your features, with guidance from DevOps.
Dependencies: Surface cross-team dependencies early.
Clear Communication: Explain technical trade-offs clearly to Product and Quality.
AI-assisted Engineering: Use approved AI tools across implementation, testing, debugging and refactoring, while remaining accountable for correctness and maintainability.

Success looks like: predictable delivery, stable production, more tech debt paid down than introduced in your area, and low escaped defects and rework on the changes you own. All of this comes from strong feature ownership, systems thinking, valuable code-review contributions and dependability.

What You'll Bring

Hands-on .NET engineering experience, typically gained over 3+ years of professional work. We look for proven depth rather than years alone, and assess this case by case.
Experience with .NET Framework 4.8 and/or .NET 10, and C#.
