jobs.description:
Tâches et responsabilités

Chef de projet IT

Vous encadrez des équipes techniques, coordonnez les parties prenantes et pilotez des projets selon la méthodologie Agile Scrum. Cela comprend la planification, la gestion des priorités, l’animation des cérémonies Scrum et le reporting régulier. Selon votre profil, vous intervenez également comme référent technique auprès des équipes. La fonction combine donc des dimensions managériales et techniques, avec l’appui d’un comité de pilotage pour les décisions clés.

Au cours des 4 à 6 premiers mois, vous prenez principalement en charge la maintenance et la migration de fonctionnalités d’une application legacy de type client lourd Windows, utilisée pour la gestion d’enquêtes et la rédaction de procès-verbaux. En parallèle, vous soutenez le lancement d’un nouveau projet de plateforme web moderne de type Case Management System, destiné à répondre à un besoin opérationnel critique dans le cadre de la coopération policière internationale.

La nouvelle solution repose sur une architecture moderne basée sur des microservices, des micro frontends Angular, la conteneurisation, la haute disponibilité et la scalabilité. Une fois la migration terminée, votre focus se portera principalement sur ce nouveau projet, tout en conservant un suivi plus limité de la maintenance et du support de l’application legacy jusqu’à son remplacement complet.

Pour chacun des projets, vous définissez les délais, organisez les priorités et veillez à l’atteinte des objectifs, sous la supervision d’un Program Manager responsable de l’ensemble.

Missions principales

Prendre connaissance de l’existant et proposer des pistes techniques pour stabiliser certaines parties de l’application legacy.
Veiller à la compatibilité de l’application legacy avec les futures versions de Windows et à sa stabilité en exécution.
Superviser les développements backend et frontend, ainsi que la mise en place des tests unitaires et d’intégration.
Encadrer le développement d’une application web SPA responsive selon une architecture micro-frontend.
Veiller à une bonne gestion du code source avec Git, GitLab, branches, pull requests et code reviews.
S’assurer de la rédaction de la documentation technique par les équipes.
Piloter les aspects DevOps, y compris la mise en place des pipelines CI/CD pour les applications, les services et l’infrastructure, notamment dans des environnements Kubernetes et IaC.
Suivre les priorités, ajuster le planning si nécessaire et communiquer régulièrement l’état d’avancement au comité de pilotage.
Contribuer à la mise en œuvre de solutions sécurisées by design, y compris sur les volets authentification et intégration.
Accompagner la modélisation fonctionnelle et technique via UML et BPMN, ainsi que le suivi du monitoring avec des outils tels que Grafana.

Votre profil

Vous êtes titulaire au minimum d’un bachelier en informatique, idéalement complété par un master, et vous justifiez de plusieurs années d’expérience en développement logiciel, y compris dans des rôles techniques, ainsi que dans une fonction similaire.

Vous combinez leadership, capacité de coordination et crédibilité technique. Vous savez fédérer des interlocuteurs variés, construire rapidement un réseau de collaboration, faire preuve d’empathie et adopter la fermeté nécessaire lorsque la situation l’exige. Vous adaptez votre style de management aux profils de l’équipe et savez évaluer les compétences afin d’attribuer les bonnes tâches aux bonnes personnes.

Vous gérez efficacement les priorités, savez faire évoluer les plans en cas d’imprévus et travaillez avec une forte orientation résultats. Les cérémonies Scrum telles que Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-up, Review et Rétrospective font partie de votre pratique quotidienne.

Sur le plan technique, vous disposez de bonnes connaissances en .NET (C#), appliquées notamment à des architectures microservices. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les API REST ou gRPC, les approches event-driven, ainsi qu’avec le développement d’applications web de type SPA en Angular, HTML et CSS selon une architecture micro-frontend.

Vous maîtrisez les mécanismes d’authentification via OpenID Connect et O365, tant pour les services backend que pour les applications frontend. Vous avez également une expérience confirmée en CI/CD et en mise en place de pipelines de déploiement avec GitLab. Vous maîtrisez Git et êtes familier des concepts de branches, pull requests et revues de code.

Vous avez de bonnes bases en bases de données relationnelles, notamment PostgreSQL. Une expérience en Infrastructure as Code constitue une plus-value importante, tout comme des connaissances en cryptographie, en Delphi ou en outils de monitoring tels que Grafana ou Prometheus.

La maîtrise de l’anglais ainsi que d’une des deux langues nationales est requise. La connaissance active d’une langue nationale et au minimum passive de l’autre représente un atout supplémentaire. Une connaissance du fonctionnement des services de police constitue également un avantage.

Soft Skills

Capacité à fédérer des profils hétérogènes autour d’un objectif commun
Persévérance face aux difficultés majeures
Capacité à temporiser et à maintenir un climat constructif sous pression
Esprit d’initiative et proactivité
Sens des priorités et vision à long terme
Orientation utilisateur et sens du terrain
Communication claire, fluide et adaptée à différents publics
Vision transverse intégrant les dimensions techniques, humaines, organisationnelles et politiques
Esprit analytique et capacité à identifier les causes profondes des problèmes

Hard Skills

Gestion de projet complexe en environnement Agile, avec une maîtrise particulière de Scrum
Modernisation d’applications et transition d’un client lourd vers une solution web moderne
Conception sécurisée et sécurité by design
Modélisation logicielle avec UML et BPMN
Monitoring avec Grafana ou Prometheus
Architecture microservices, microfrontend (Angular) et event-driven
Développement en .NET (C#), Angular, HTML et CSS
Tests unitaires et d’intégration
Bases de données relationnelles, notamment PostgreSQL
DevOps avec GitLab, CI/CD, Kubernetes et IaC
Authentification via OpenID et O365

Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Flexibilidad horaria.

jobs.title: NetSuite Junior Developer
jobs.description:
Junior NetSuite Developer Role Description

This is a full-time, fully remote role for a Junior Developer at MindCloud, an Oracle NetSuite Alliance Partner. You'll support the configuration, customisation, and maintenance of NetSuite solutions for our clients and internal products, working alongside senior developers who'll mentor you from day one.

Your work will span scripting, workflows, and integrations. As well as core NetSuite development, MindCloud builds AI-powered products on top of the platform — including tools that use large language model APIs to automate document processing — so there's real scope to grow into modern web and AI development as you progress. Day to day, you'll help build and modify SuiteScript customisations, troubleshoot system issues, implement enhancements, prepare technical documentation, and take part in testing and deployment.

You'll collaborate closely with consultants, project managers, and end users to understand business requirements and translate them into clean, practical technical solutions. We invest heavily in development: through MindCloud Academy you'll receive structured training, certification support, and continuous mentoring on your way to becoming a skilled NetSuite developer.

What You'll Do

Assist in developing and modifying SuiteScript (JavaScript-based) customisations, workflows, and integrations under the guidance of senior developers.
Build and maintain custom records, fields, forms, roles, and workflows in NetSuite.
Support the development of integrations between NetSuite and external systems and APIs.
Contribute to MindCloud's AI-powered products, including features built on large language model APIs.
Troubleshoot and debug functional and technical issues, and implement small enhancements.
Prepare technical documentation and participate in testing and deployment.
Learn and apply NetSuite development best practices, with openness to feedback and code review.

What We're Looking For

Knowledge of programming fundamentals and at least one scripting language —  JavaScript preferred
, as SuiteScript is JavaScript-based.
Familiarity with web technologies such as  HTML, CSS, and working with REST APIs / JSON
.
Interest in  AI and large language models
, and curiosity about applying them to real business problems (hands-on experience is a plus, not a requirement).
Ability to understand business processes in accounting, finance, or operations and translate requirements into technical specifications.
Foundational exposure to software testing, debugging, and documentation.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organisational skills, with attention to detail.
Effective written and verbal communication, and the ability to collaborate with a remote, cross-functional team.
Motivation to learn NetSuite and cloud ERP technologies, with openness to mentoring.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

Exposure to SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, or other ERP scripting tools.
Experience with Node.js, Python, or building/consuming APIs.
Any project — academic, personal, or professional — involving AI, automation, or web development.
Prior exposure to ERP systems, SaaS products, or business applications.

What You'll Get

Comprehensive onboarding through MindCloud Academy.
Structured NetSuite training and certification support.
Continuous mentoring from experienced developers and consultants.
Hands-on experience on real client projects and on MindCloud's own AI products.
A collaborative, supportive, fully remote working environment.
Clear career progression towards Developer and Senior Developer roles.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Descripción de la empresa

T-Systems es parte del grupo Deutsche Telekom, con unos 30.000 empleados en todo el mundo. Creamos tecnología con propósito para generar un impacto positivo en la sociedad. Buscamos talento curioso, con ganas de aprender, asumir retos y aportar ideas que transformen la experiencia de nuestros clientes.

Confiamos en las personas: ofrecemos autonomía, apoyo continuo y un entorno colaborativo donde crecer sin límites. Somos un solo equipo global, guiados por el respeto, la integridad y la pasión por hacerlo mejor cada día.

Descripción del empleo

Buscamos Senior AI Engineers
para participar en la construcción e industrialización de soluciones empresariales basadas en inteligencia artificial generativa, RAG, agentes inteligentes, automatización, integración con sistemas corporativos y servicios cloud.

Las personas seleccionadas formarán parte de equipos técnicos multidisciplinares y participarán en la implementación real de componentes IA, pipelines de datos, servicios backend, integración con APIs, agentes, prompts, herramientas, automatizaciones y mecanismos de evaluación.

Se requiere un perfil senior, práctico, con experiencia sólida en desarrollo software y conocimiento aplicado de IA generativa.

Evaluaremos candidaturas de todo el territorio nacional, especialmente Sevilla, Granada, Tarragona, Madrid, Valencia... Ciudades donde contamos con centros de trabajo.

Responsabilidades

Diseñar, desarrollar e integrar componentes de IA generativa en soluciones empresariales.
Implementar servicios, APIs, conectores y componentes backend para exponer capacidades IA.
Construir pipelines de ingesta, normalización, procesamiento y preparación de datos estructurados y no estructurados.
Implementar soluciones RAG sobre documentación, bases de conocimiento, datos históricos, repositorios documentales y fuentes corporativas.
Trabajar con LLMs, embeddings, bases de datos vectoriales, motores de búsqueda semántica y frameworks de agentes.
Diseñar e implementar prompts, tools, workflows, agentes y mecanismos de generación estructurada.
Integrar soluciones IA con APIs, servicios internos, servicios externos, herramientas corporativas y sistemas legacy.
Participar en el desarrollo y terminación de servicios mediante herramientas de generación automática de código.
Implementar automatizaciones mediante APIs, scripts, runbooks, workflows o RPA cuando aplique.
Participar en la definición e implementación de métricas de calidad, evaluación de respuestas, pruebas técnicas y validación de resultados.
Colaborar con arquitectos, equipos cloud, equipos de desarrollo, operación, seguridad y stakeholders funcionales.
Participar en la mejora continua de herramientas internas de IA, aceleradores, prompts, agentes, pipelines y building blocks.
Mantenerse al día con los últimos avances en IA aplicada, desarrollo software, RAG, agentes, automatización y cloud.

Requisitos

Requisitos

Experiencia mínima de 3 años en desarrollo de software y participación en delivery de proyectos tecnológicos.
Conocimiento de herramientas ITSM, CRM, ERP, portales corporativos, repositorios documentales o sistemas legacy.
Experiencia práctica en soluciones de IA generativa, LLMs, RAG, agentes o automatización inteligente.
Conocimientos en LLMs, embeddings, bases de datos vectoriales, prompting, recuperación semántica y evaluación de respuestas.
Experiencia en desarrollo backend, APIs e integración de sistemas.
Conocimientos sólidos de desarrollo en Java, .NET, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript u otros stacks empresariales.
Dominio o buen conocimiento de frameworks JavaScript: Angular, React, Vue u otros.
Experiencia con GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps u otras herramientas de control de versiones y CI/CD.
Conocimientos de SDLC, DevOps, testing, observabilidad, quality gates y buenas prácticas de ingeniería software.
Experiencia integrando soluciones con APIs, servicios internos, servicios externos y sistemas corporativos.
Experiencia en metodologías de gestión de proyectos clásicas, ágiles o híbridas.
Experiencia en participación en ejecución de proyectos tecnológicos.
Titulación en Informática, Telecomunicaciones, Ingeniería o similar. Recomendable MECES 2 o experiencia equivalente demostrable.

Requisitos valorables

Python aplicado a IA, automatización, datos o integración.
Experiencia con LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI o frameworks equivalentes.
Experiencia con Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, OpenAI API, Anthropic, Vertex AI, modelos open-source o plataformas similares.
Experiencia con bases vectoriales: Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus, Chroma, Pinecone, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch u otras.
Experiencia en NLP, clasificación, extracción de entidades, clustering, matching semántico o minería de texto.
Experiencia en automatización mediante APIs, scripts, RPA, workflows, runbooks o herramientas de orquestación.
Experiencia en observabilidad: logs, métricas, trazas, health checks, dashboards o AIOps.
Conocimientos en Platform Engineering, building blocks tooling, herramientas de compliance, SBOM, quality gates y gobierno técnico.
Certificaciones o formación en IA generativa, prompt engineering, cloud, DevOps o desarrollo software.
Experiencia en entornos cloud: Azure, AWS, GCP,...
Experiencia en entornos legacy o modernización de aplicaciones.

Perfil personal

Curiosidad tecnológica y mentalidad maker.
Interés por nuevas herramientas, arquitecturas y diferentes enfoques de desarrollo e IA.
Perfil colaborativo, dispuesto a asumir tareas diversas y liderar técnicamente cuando sea necesario.

Autonomía para investigar, proponer, construir, probar y documentar soluciones.
Buena comunicación con perfiles técnicos, funcionales y de cliente.
Mentalidad pragmática para balancear innovación, mantenibilidad y valor real de negocio.

Build the cloud platform that’s transforming electronics design. Utilizing AI and ML to power advanced search capabilities

Stateful and stateless servers, relational databases, ORM frameworks

Senior Software Engineer

AWS cloud

Deep expertise in one or more of these areas:

identity and authentication, access or license management, message queues/brokers,

platform framework development, multi-tenancy, Rings Protection Model in cloud development
Proven experience building and operating distributed, high-load systems, including performance profiling, optimisation, load testing, and stress testing

Experience defining and driving engineering standards, best practices, and technical governance at a platform level

jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re Hiring:
Principal Engineer for a hybrid project, 2 days per week on-site, in Lisbon or Porto.

About the Role

You will enable product teams to deliver software more predictably, efficiently and safely by combining deep full-stack engineering expertise with practical leadership of an AI-enabled SDLC. The role operates across teams, builds reference implementations, solves complex cross-stack problems, strengthens engineering standards and helps Tech Leads adopt repeatable AI-assisted practices with appropriate human validation and governance.
You will act as an individual contributor with cross-team influence and no direct people-management responsibility, working closely with Tech Leads, Architects, Engineering Management, Product, Quality Engineering, Security, Data and Platform teams. You move between strategic direction and hands-on delivery depending on the problem and level of technical risk.
The ideal candidate influences through technical credibility, clear reasoning and collaboration. You remain hands-on and demonstrate proposed approaches in working code, balance engineering ambition with pragmatism, and communicate complex topics clearly to engineering, architecture, product and leadership audiences. You create leverage by enabling others and value security, transparency, traceability and accountability in the use of AI.

Main Responsibilities:

Full-Stack Technical Leadership
Define and drive the React Native
technology roadmap, leading continuous improvement of the mobile app's performance, stability, security and release process.
Provide expert guidance across frontend, mobile, backend, APIs, integrations, data persistence, cloud, CI/CD, observability and production operations.
Lead technical discovery and engineering spikes for complex or high-risk initiatives.
Build and maintain reference implementations that demonstrate approved patterns and accelerate adoption.
Review designs and critical implementation decisions for scalability, maintainability, security, resilience and cost.
Help teams diagnose complex production and cross-system issues when normal escalation paths are insufficient.

Engineering Excellence and Enablement
Strengthen clean architecture, Domain-Driven Design, secure coding, automated testing, trunk-based development, CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
Contribute to clear Definition of Ready and Definition of Done criteria, with focus on technical readiness, testability and operability.
Create playbooks, templates, checklists and automation that make the preferred way of working easy to adopt.
Coach Tech Leads and engineers through pairing, design sessions, code reviews, workshops and communities of practice.
Promote pragmatic technical debt management, balancing delivery with long-term sustainability.

Architecture, Reliability and Security
Implement architecture principles in working software and provide feedback to the Lead Architect.
Champion API-first, event-driven and decoupled integration patterns when appropriate.
Embed security by design, threat-aware engineering and privacy considerations into delivery.
Advance application observability through structured logging, metrics, traces, alerting, service-level indicators and runbooks.
Guide and help improve resilience, recoverability and operability of critical services.
Support FinOps practices by guiding balanced cloud consumption and operational cost in design choices.

Requirements:

Mandatory
5+ years of relevant experience
Proven experience as Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, Senior Tech Lead or equivalent senior individual contributor.

The systems you build and work with will solve major business challenges with a focus on Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) & Quality Systems at Harman.

The role is not transactional and not focused on only building and delivering code. It is focused on building Business Solutions based on real Problem Statements with freedom to create fit-for-purpose applications.

You are expected and encouraged to stay on with the latest and greatest technological trends to create value in your designs and in the business application.

Translate complex business requirements into clear domain models, data structures, and system behavior.

Analyze and resolve complex system, data, and process issues using structured root cause analysis.

Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming and design principles

Masters Degree

,

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Secure AI agents
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

We’re building foundational infrastructure to secure AI agents—including their identities, access patterns, and interactions with sensitive systems and data.

This includes designing intelligent, dynamic mechanisms for ephemeral access control, secrets management, and agent and user identity tailored to the

modern agent ecosystem.

As a Principal Engineer, you’ll take ownership of these critical systems, designing and implementing how agents establish identity, receive dynamic access,

securely interact with sensitive systems, and leave verifiable audit trails. You’ll shape the long-term architecture, anticipate technical risks, and evolve

systems that span both machine- and human-facing workflows.

This is a rare opportunity to combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership—writing critical code, mentoring engineers, sharing knowledge, and

driving best practices—while building a platform from the ground up at the cutting edge of AI, identity, and security.

Responsibilities

Own and guide the technical direction of core platform domains, including agent identity, authentication, authorization, and secrets management,
shaping architectures that span multiple services and teams while balancing scalability, reliability, and security.
Lead by example through high-impact implementation, mentoring engineers, and helping them navigate complex technical tradeoffs.
Proactively identify critical technical problems or gaps, and drive solutions from concept through delivery.
Establish and promote engineering best practices, ensuring high standards for code quality, security, and operational excellence.
Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, architects, product managers, and stakeholders, influencing decisions, fostering
alignment, and driving cross-team collaboration.
Document key decisions, patterns, and practices to elevate team knowledge and ensure consistency across the platform.
Advocate for continuous improvement and operational efficiency, helping the team work smarter while maintaining a secure, high-quality platform.

Qualifications

You bring 8+ years of experience in backend and systems with a track record of owning large-scale or security-critical systems end-to-end.
You’ve designed and operated distributed, cloud-based architectures that are secure, scalable, and reliable, and you’re comfortable working with AWS, GCP, or Azure.
You have experience or a strong interest in identity, authentication, authorization, and secrets management, and you’re excited to apply these principles to AI and agent frameworks—this will give you an edge.
You thrive in ambiguity, make high-impact technical decisions, and guide others through complex tradeoffs with confidence.
You communicate clearly and effectively, influencing decisions, aligning teams, and mentoring engineers across multiple functions.
You’re passionate about sharing knowledge, raising the technical bar, and multiplying the impact of your peers and the team.
You are self-driven, proactive, and organized, with a strong focus on delivering high-quality, secure, and scalable solutions that make a real difference.

What You Will Get

Additional health insurance with dental treatment included
Life / permanent disability insurance
Sick Leave allowance
Mobile phone plan
FLEX Benefits wallet
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (Booking Integrations)
jobs.description:
About The Team

Breakneck Studio
– an incubator and accelerator scaling digital and e-commerce brands at high velocity. It’s home to our Co-Found program, where ambitious founders take products from zero to market in months, not years. This is where you get hands-on, zero-to-scale experience you won’t find in a regular job.

We are looking

We are a fast-scaling travel startup with strong product-market fit, a generational traveltech company looking to disturb this sleepy industry. We are two-sided: travelers get a consumer product that helps them plan and book trips, and advisors get a SaaS-style subscription with certification and qualified leads in the offer.

We’re looking for the first developers to join a fast-growing travel startup that’s already found strong product-market fit and is now ready to scale.

This is not a role for someone who wants to manage agencies, coordinate stakeholders, or spend weeks building presentations. We’re looking for a builder – someone who can design a schema for breakfast, build a sandbox environment for lunch, load test it before dinner, and wake up excited to get it ready for prod the upcoming week.

You’ll work directly with the founder and early team, own growth from day one, and help shape what the product looks like as the company scales. Work-life balance can look different in a fast-moving company that’s on a mission to make a real impact.

Ready to apply?

Jump to the application form and start your journey with us.

Apply Now

Get ready to

Design, build, and own integrations with third-party booking systems such as suppliers, booking platforms, and partner APIs, covering everything from modern REST/OAuth APIs to legacy SOAP services.
Architect the webhook ingestion and worker queue infrastructure that keeps bookings, availability, and status updates flowing reliably at scale.
Design database schemas in Supabase (PostgreSQL) that model complex booking data cleanly and hold up as volume grows.
Build sandbox and testing environments so integrations can be developed, validated, and debugged safely before they reach production.
Load test and harden services, finding bottlenecks and failure points before customers do.
Take integrations from prototype to production: monitoring, alerting, retries, idempotency, and graceful handling of flaky third-party systems.
Make sure credentials, tokens, and traveler data are handled securely across every integration.
Help evolve our TypeScript, Supabase, and TanStack MVP into a scalable, production-grade platform, and make key architectural decisions along the way.
Work directly with the founder and early team to decide which integrations matter most for travelers and advisors, and ship them fast.
Set the engineering standards, patterns, and practices that future developers will build on as the team grows.

We expect you to

Strong software engineering fundamentals, with deep experience in Authentication & Identity and Backend Software Engineering (PostgreSQL, PHP/Laravel, Node.js/TypeScript).
Expert-level understanding of API authentication across many integration styles, including:
OAuth 2.0 (authorization code, client credentials, PKCE, refresh token rotation) and OIDC
SOAP APIs, including WS-Security, XML signatures and certificate-based authentication
REST API auth patterns such as API keys, HMAC request signing, JWT and mutual TLS

Proven experience designing secure, scalable webhook systems: signature verification, idempotency, replay protection, deduplication, ordering, rate limiting and dead-letter handling.
Hands-on experience building asynchronous job processing with AWS SQS workers, Temporal workflows, or an equivalent durable execution or queue system, including retries, backoff and failure recovery.
Experience integrating with a wide variety of third-party systems, including poorly documented or legacy APIs, and building abstractions that make new integrations faster to add.
Secure handling of credentials and secrets at scale, such as token storage, encryption, rotation and per-tenant isolation.
Strong TypeScript skills, as it is the team’s primary development language.
Solid grasp of engineering best practices, automation and observability, using tools such as Datadog for monitoring and alerting on integration health.
Comfortable in an agile, collaborative environment, communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including external partners’ engineering teams.
Experience leading technical initiatives, influencing architectural decisions or providing technical leadership across teams.

Salary

Gross salary range is 6000-8000 EUR/month + stock options (ESOP) depending on your experience.

Location

We have several great workspaces to choose from, including our headquarters in Vilnius and our hubs in Klaipėda and Riga.

For our Vilnius office, we follow a 4 days onsite, 1 day remote
hybrid model. For roles based outside Vilnius, the work arrangement -onsite, hybrid, or remote-depends on the specific position.

Speaking Of Perks

Own your wellness

Stay sharp and well in your own way – health insurance (after probation), on-site physiotherapist, office gym, and fitness classes keep you moving. Plus 7 extra days off, 3 for weddings, hybrid work, and the freedom to work 2 months from anywhere in the world.

Boost your daily life

Every breakthrough needs a spark and our daily setup reflects that. Pet-friendly office, fresh breakfasts, hot lunches, drawers and fridges stocked with snacks and food – for a quick bite or even a team-cooked meal together. Rooftop and cellar events keep things lively, while 10 social clubs give space to dive into passions and try new things. Add a public transport card for Vilnius and Perks.lt perks for smoother days.

Shape your growth path

Builders never stop learning. Coaching, mentorship, training, conferences, online courses, subscriptions, books – you’ve got a €1000 yearly budget to fuel personal or team growth. You pick the path – we’ll back you all the way.

Drive global impact

This is where ambition scales. Build impact across 30+ brands worldwide. Launch bold projects. Even step in as a co-founder – we reward those who push further. And if you bring in more great people, you get €1500 for every successful referral.

additional conditions apply based on your residence location.

Ready to apply?

Jump to the application form and start your journey with us.

Apply Now

jobs.title: Solutions Developer
jobs.description:
About Mixvoip
We are Mixvoip, a Luxembourg-based company providing Cloud Telephony, Connectivity, Cybersecurity, and Managed IT Services to businesses and public organizations.
We design, operate, and support many of our solutions ourselves. When we see an inefficient process, a missing integration, or an opportunity to create a better customer experience, we like to build something that solves it.
That’s where you come in.
About the role
You will join Mixvoip’s IT Services team as a Solutions Developer.
Your role sits between software development, infrastructure, automation, and product design.
You will build internal tools that make our teams more efficient, automate repetitive processes, connect systems through APIs, and contribute to customer-facing products.
Projects can be very different from one another. You might build a small automation in Python, a backend service in Rust or C#, a React interface, an integration between several platforms, or a complete solution combining software, infrastructure, authentication, APIs, and physical devices.
We are therefore not looking for someone attached to one specific framework.
We are looking for someone who can understand a problem, choose an appropriate technical approach, prototype quickly, and turn the result into something secure, reliable, understandable, and maintainable.
AI-assisted development is part of how we work. You should be comfortable using coding assistants and development agents such as Codex, Claude, or similar tools to explore codebases, build features, refactor, test, document, and accelerate development.
The important part is not how much code AI can generate for you. It is whether you understand what is being built and remain responsible for the architecture, security, quality, and operation of the final solution.
Key responsibilities
Design and develop internal applications, automation, and operational tools

Contribute to customer-facing products and new commercial solutions

Translate operational or business needs into practical software solutions

Prototype ideas quickly and turn successful prototypes into production-ready systems

Work across technologies such as Rust, Python, C#, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vite, and similar tools

Build and integrate APIs, webhooks, databases, internal systems, and third-party services

Design frontend, backend, and service components when required

Apply appropriate software architecture and design patterns without unnecessary complexity

Implement authentication, authorization, and secure handling of application data

Write maintainable, testable, and understandable code

Review both human-written and AI-generated code critically

Build automated tests and contribute to CI/CD and deployment processes

Deploy and operate applications in Linux, Windows, containerized, cloud, or on-premises environments

Troubleshoot across application and infrastructure layers, including logs, networking, databases, APIs, permissions, and services

Implement appropriate logging, monitoring, and health checks

Document architecture, dependencies, APIs, deployment procedures, and important technical decisions

Identify manual or repetitive work that could be simplified through software or automation

Work closely with systems engineers, network engineers, support teams, and other colleagues across Mixvoip

What do we need from you?
Strong software development fundamentals

Professional experience building applications, tools, automation, platforms, or software products

Experience with more than one programming language or technology stack

Strong knowledge of at least one backend language such as Rust, Python, C#, or similar

Experience with modern web development using TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vite, or comparable technologies

Good understanding of APIs, HTTP, authentication, webhooks, databases, and system integrations

Good understanding of software architecture and common design patterns

Experience with Git, code reviews, testing, and collaborative development workflows

Good understanding of application security

Good infrastructure fundamentals, including networking, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, operating systems, permissions, and reverse proxies

Comfortable working with Linux and the command line

Familiarity with containers and modern deployment practices

Strong experience using AI coding assistants and development agents in real development work

Ability to review AI-generated solutions critically and recognize when they are incorrect, insecure, or unnecessarily complex

Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies quickly

Good documentation habits

Professional proficiency in English

You do not need to be an expert in every technology we use.
Strong fundamentals, adaptability, and good engineering judgment matter more to us than knowing a specific framework by heart.
What would make you stand out?
Experience with Rust, Python, C#, or .NET

Advanced TypeScript and React experience

Experience building internal tools or operational platforms

Experience turning manual business processes into software and automation

Experience developing customer-facing software products

Experience integrating hardware, meeting room equipment, embedded devices, or IoT systems

Why Mixvoip?

Microsoft Foundry & GenAI: Praktijkervaring met LLM-implementaties, vector search, embeddings, prompt engineering, tool/function calling en Responsible AI-richtlijnen.

new_jobs.title: Solution Architect – verksamhetsnära lösningar som gör skillnad
new_jobs.description:
På IT‑Total arbetar vi nära våra kunder och deras verksamhet.

Vi kombinerar teknisk spets med affärsförståelse och långsiktiga relationer. Nu söker vi en Solution Architect
som vill ta ett tydligt helhetsansvar för att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till hållbara tekniska lösningar – och samtidigt vara en trygg rådgivare för både kund och team.

Om rollen

Som Solution Architect hos oss har du en central och verksamhetsnära roll. Du fungerar som länken mellan kund, utvecklingsteam och projektledning och ansvarar för att säkerställa att rätt lösning tas fram – både tekniskt och affärsmässigt.

Du arbetar genom hela kedjan: från tidiga dialoger, workshops och kravinsamling till teknisk arkitektur, offertarbete och leverans. Rollen kräver att du är bekväm med att ta ledning, fatta tekniska beslut och föra en pedagogisk dialog med beställare som ofta finns i verksamheten snarare än inom IT.

Rollen kombinerar strategiskt ansvar med praktiskt arbete och passar dig som trivs med att vara nära både teknik och kund. I rollen som Solution Architect kommer du bland annat att:

Analysera kunders verksamhetsprocesser och identifiera behov och förbättringsmöjligheter
Leda och genomföra workshops, kravinsamling och tekniska diskussioner tillsammans med kund och interna team
Omsätta verksamhetskrav till lösningsarkitektur och tekniska förslag
Designa och ta ansvar för lösningar inom applikationsutveckling, modern infrastruktur, dataplattformar och integration
Leda agila leveransteam och säkerställa kvalitet, skalbarhet och säkerhet i leveransen
Vara teknisk rådgivare och driva kundens digitala utveckling framåt över tid

Din bakgrund

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

Minst 5 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom systemutveckling och/eller arkitektur
Akademisk examen inom exempelvis datateknik eller systemvetenskap
Gedigen erfarenhet av applikationsutveckling, särskilt inom .NET och C#
God förståelse för modern infrastruktur, dataplattformar och integration mellan system
Erfarenhet av att arbeta kundnära och ta ansvar för tekniska helhetslösningar

Rollen ställer höga krav på både teknisk bredd och djup, varför en stabil akademisk grund är viktig.

Vem du är

Som person är du analytisk, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad. Du är socialt trygg och van att ta en ledande roll i dialog med kund, där du kombinerar teknisk kompetens med affärsdriv och stark verksamhetsförståelse. Du arbetar självständigt, tar ansvar för dina beslut och är bekväm med att fatta tekniska vägval som påverkar både kund och leverans.

Varför kommer du att trivas på IT-Total?

IT-Total föddes ur idén att vara det bästa företaget för medarbetare inom sin bransch, därför välkomnar vi dig till en arbetsplats som ger dig glädje, stimulans och möjlighet att växa inom det område du brinner för. Vi är en innovativ arbetsgivare som satsar på din framtid och jobbar i teknikens framkant med ett högt säkerhetstänk. Med säkerhetsprövade medarbetare och säkerhetsklassade lokaler- och datahallar garanterar vi trygghet och integritet för våra kunder.

Vi erbjuder:

🥪 En himmelsk fredagsfrukost med kollegorna

🌍 Hybrid arbetsplats

💑 Roligt på jobbet - allt från träning till resor och spelkvällar

🍏 Ett välfyllt lager av frukt, nötter, gudomligt kaffe från en Kunglig Hovleverantör om så önskas.

🍰 Fredagsfika tillsammans

🏡 Ett stenkast till både shopping på Mall of Scandinavia och natursköna Brunnsviken som är perfekt för löpning och lunchpromenader

✔ Goda och trygga anställningsvillkor.

🙌 Frihet att styra din egen utveckling och ditt eget arbete, vi tror på "Work life balance"

👩🏽‍🤝‍🧑🏼 Kollegor i världsklass som bryr sig 💛

🚗 Goda parkeringsmöjligheter

🏌️‍♂️ Generöst friskvårdsbidrag

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan i formuläret nedan.

Har du några frågor gällande tjänsten?

new_jobs.description:
Tâches et responsabilités

Chef de projet IT

Vous encadrez des équipes techniques, coordonnez les parties prenantes et pilotez des projets selon la méthodologie Agile Scrum. Cela comprend la planification, la gestion des priorités, l’animation des cérémonies Scrum et le reporting régulier. Selon votre profil, vous intervenez également comme référent technique auprès des équipes. La fonction combine donc des dimensions managériales et techniques, avec l’appui d’un comité de pilotage pour les décisions clés.

Au cours des 4 à 6 premiers mois, vous prenez principalement en charge la maintenance et la migration de fonctionnalités d’une application legacy de type client lourd Windows, utilisée pour la gestion d’enquêtes et la rédaction de procès-verbaux. En parallèle, vous soutenez le lancement d’un nouveau projet de plateforme web moderne de type Case Management System, destiné à répondre à un besoin opérationnel critique dans le cadre de la coopération policière internationale.

La nouvelle solution repose sur une architecture moderne basée sur des microservices, des micro frontends Angular, la conteneurisation, la haute disponibilité et la scalabilité. Une fois la migration terminée, votre focus se portera principalement sur ce nouveau projet, tout en conservant un suivi plus limité de la maintenance et du support de l’application legacy jusqu’à son remplacement complet.

Pour chacun des projets, vous définissez les délais, organisez les priorités et veillez à l’atteinte des objectifs, sous la supervision d’un Program Manager responsable de l’ensemble.

Missions principales

Prendre connaissance de l’existant et proposer des pistes techniques pour stabiliser certaines parties de l’application legacy.
Veiller à la compatibilité de l’application legacy avec les futures versions de Windows et à sa stabilité en exécution.
Superviser les développements backend et frontend, ainsi que la mise en place des tests unitaires et d’intégration.
Encadrer le développement d’une application web SPA responsive selon une architecture micro-frontend.
Veiller à une bonne gestion du code source avec Git, GitLab, branches, pull requests et code reviews.
S’assurer de la rédaction de la documentation technique par les équipes.
Piloter les aspects DevOps, y compris la mise en place des pipelines CI/CD pour les applications, les services et l’infrastructure, notamment dans des environnements Kubernetes et IaC.
Suivre les priorités, ajuster le planning si nécessaire et communiquer régulièrement l’état d’avancement au comité de pilotage.
Contribuer à la mise en œuvre de solutions sécurisées by design, y compris sur les volets authentification et intégration.
Accompagner la modélisation fonctionnelle et technique via UML et BPMN, ainsi que le suivi du monitoring avec des outils tels que Grafana.

Votre profil

Vous êtes titulaire au minimum d’un bachelier en informatique, idéalement complété par un master, et vous justifiez de plusieurs années d’expérience en développement logiciel, y compris dans des rôles techniques, ainsi que dans une fonction similaire.

Vous combinez leadership, capacité de coordination et crédibilité technique. Vous savez fédérer des interlocuteurs variés, construire rapidement un réseau de collaboration, faire preuve d’empathie et adopter la fermeté nécessaire lorsque la situation l’exige. Vous adaptez votre style de management aux profils de l’équipe et savez évaluer les compétences afin d’attribuer les bonnes tâches aux bonnes personnes.

Vous gérez efficacement les priorités, savez faire évoluer les plans en cas d’imprévus et travaillez avec une forte orientation résultats. Les cérémonies Scrum telles que Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-up, Review et Rétrospective font partie de votre pratique quotidienne.

Sur le plan technique, vous disposez de bonnes connaissances en .NET (C#), appliquées notamment à des architectures microservices. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les API REST ou gRPC, les approches event-driven, ainsi qu’avec le développement d’applications web de type SPA en Angular, HTML et CSS selon une architecture micro-frontend.

Vous maîtrisez les mécanismes d’authentification via OpenID Connect et O365, tant pour les services backend que pour les applications frontend. Vous avez également une expérience confirmée en CI/CD et en mise en place de pipelines de déploiement avec GitLab. Vous maîtrisez Git et êtes familier des concepts de branches, pull requests et revues de code.

Vous avez de bonnes bases en bases de données relationnelles, notamment PostgreSQL. Une expérience en Infrastructure as Code constitue une plus-value importante, tout comme des connaissances en cryptographie, en Delphi ou en outils de monitoring tels que Grafana ou Prometheus.

La maîtrise de l’anglais ainsi que d’une des deux langues nationales est requise. La connaissance active d’une langue nationale et au minimum passive de l’autre représente un atout supplémentaire. Une connaissance du fonctionnement des services de police constitue également un avantage.

Soft Skills

Capacité à fédérer des profils hétérogènes autour d’un objectif commun
Persévérance face aux difficultés majeures
Capacité à temporiser et à maintenir un climat constructif sous pression
Esprit d’initiative et proactivité
Sens des priorités et vision à long terme
Orientation utilisateur et sens du terrain
Communication claire, fluide et adaptée à différents publics
Vision transverse intégrant les dimensions techniques, humaines, organisationnelles et politiques
Esprit analytique et capacité à identifier les causes profondes des problèmes

Hard Skills

Gestion de projet complexe en environnement Agile, avec une maîtrise particulière de Scrum
Modernisation d’applications et transition d’un client lourd vers une solution web moderne
Conception sécurisée et sécurité by design
Modélisation logicielle avec UML et BPMN
Monitoring avec Grafana ou Prometheus
Architecture microservices, microfrontend (Angular) et event-driven
Développement en .NET (C#), Angular, HTML et CSS
Tests unitaires et d’intégration
Bases de données relationnelles, notamment PostgreSQL
DevOps avec GitLab, CI/CD, Kubernetes et IaC
Authentification via OpenID et O365

Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development.

From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.
